descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement des grains sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et des machines dans les domaines de la transformation et de la malturation des grains et de la brassage, notamment le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris la technologie de manutention et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter les grains du champ au consommateur.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature, et à développer des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches: Avec un double diplôme en Licence en Ingénierie (B.Eng.) Génie Mécanique (m/w/d) en collaboration avec Bühler et notre université partenaire TH Ingolstadt, vous trouverez une façon très polyvalente pour votre carrière professionnelle. Dans le cours d'études avec une pratique approfondie, aucune formation professionnelle n'est terminée parallèlement à vos études, mais des phases pratiques sont passées dans l'entreprise pendant la période sans cours. Avec ce modèle vous vivrez environ 50% plus d'expérience pratique que dans les études régulières.

Le cours d'étude vous fournit non seulement des bases théoriques et pratiques solides de l'ingénierie mécanique, mais aussi la compétence méthodologique nécessaire pour comprendre des relations techniques complexes. L'accent est mis sur la formation en ingénierie - idéalement liée à des informations pratiques précieuses dans notre entreprise.

• Phases théoriques au cours des études : cours de mathématiques, de mécanique, de thermodynamique et de génie électrique. Vous pouvez définir vos propres priorités en choisissant des sujets tels que le développement et la production de produits, la méchatronics ou la technologie énergétique

• Phases pratiques chez Bühler : travaux de recherche et développement, construction, gestion de la qualité, gestion de la chaîne logistique ou gestion de projet

• Bases: Apprendre à connaître les compétences de base en ingénierie en mathématiques, physique, mécanique et sciences des matériaux

• Spécialisation : vous acquérez des connaissances spécialisées en conception et développement

• Méthodes et mise en œuvre: traitement axé sur la solution des tâches d'ingénierie pratique, y compris par l'étude et le travail pratique et l'acquisition de compétences sociales et méthodologiques

• Espace d'orientation : vous allez passer par les départements de l'atelier d'enseignement, de la recherche et du développement, de la construction prototype, de la planification de la production et de la technologie de fabrication et ainsi apprendre tous les domaines d'application possibles dans lesquels vous pourriez devenir actif après votre diplôme

• Autoresponsabilité: dès le début, vous pouvez prendre en charge vos propres projets et travailler avec d'autres stagiaires dans tout le système de formation, par exemple sur un projet de durabilité

Exigences:
• Certificat de fin d'études: Abitur (général ou relatif à la matière) ou Fachhochschulereife - idéalement avec le cours Mathématiques ou Physique

• Intérêt pour l'ingénierie mécanique : vous trouvez la technologie passionnante et avez une bonne imagination spatiale et logique

• Langue et personnalité : bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais ainsi que ouverture aux cultures étrangères, travail d'équipe et engagement

• Pratique : vous voulez étudier et acquérir en même temps une expérience pratique

• Digitalisation & Passion : Vous voulez faire avancer notre futur numérique

Nous offrons: Culture d'entreprise familiale Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme - dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique.

Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez sur un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour promouvoir votre productivité et votre innovation.

Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Événements et événements d'équipe Votre engagement nous permet de célébrer cela ensemble avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements d'équipe offrent les meilleures opportunités.

Grand café et fruits frais Profitez de nos commodités, comme le café gratuit premium et les fruits frais - pour votre début parfait de la journée!

Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nel 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. è stata fondata a Wuxi, provincia di Jiangsu. Conduciamo il mercato della lavorazione e della lavorazione del grano, della produzione alimentare di consumo, della macinazione e della dispersione con i nostri vantaggi tecnologici avanzati. Abbiamo diversi centri di applicazione indipendenti e centri di assistenza clienti per fresatura, pasta, smistamento del colore, cibo di consumo, macinazione e dispersione, fornendo soluzioni integrate per catene industriali multiple. > Con la nostra visione di “Innovazioni per un mondo migliore”, ci impegniamo a sviluppare soluzioni più innovative sfruttando le risorse globali del Gruppo Bühler e sfruttando la localizzazione. Aufgaben:
• Sviluppare e mantenere l'elettronica (analog e digital circuit design e layout) per i prodotti utilizzati sulle macchine Buhler.
• Condurre il monitoraggio hardware, test funzionali, debugging e validazione per i prodotti nuovi e esistenti.
• Analizzare i risultati dei test e identificare le cause principali dei problemi hardware durante le fasi di sviluppo e manutenzione dei prodotti.
• Interagire con i produttori di elettronica, sviluppare e mantenere i test di produzione e le attrezzature di programmazione.
• Integrazione della macchina di supporto, messa in servizio, risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione dei problemi. Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale (introduzione sul mercato, risoluzione dei problemi). Anforderungen:
• Laurea o superiore in Ingegneria Elettronica, Ingegneria Elettrica o un campo correlato.
• 3 o più anni di esperienza di sviluppo hardware
• Esperienza con progettazione di circuiti analogici e digitali, tra cui alimentazione, condizionamento del segnale, interfacce di comunicazione e circuiti di protezione.
• L'esperienza con l'integrazione di elettronica in macchine, tra cui messa a terra, schermatura, messa a terra e compatibilità elettromagnetica (EMC) è un plus.
• Proficienza con strumenti di cattura schematica e progettazione PCB, preferibilmente Altium Designer.
• Buone capacità di lettura, scrittura e comunicazione verbale per la collaborazione internazionale e la documentazione tecnica. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. was established in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. We lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and grinding and dispersion with our advanced technology advantages. We have several independent application centers and customer service centers for milling, pasta, color sorting, consumer food, grinding and dispersion, providing integrated solutions for multiple industry chains.
With our vision of “Innovations for a better world”, we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization. Aufgaben: • Develop and maintain electronics (analog and digital circuit design and layout) for products used on Buhler machines. • Conduct hardware bring-up, functional testing, debugging, and validation for new and existing products. • Analyze test results and identify root causes of hardware issues during development and product maintenance stages. • Interact with electronics manufacturers, develop and maintain production test and programming equipment. • Support machine integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and issue resolution. Willingness to travel internationally (market introductions, troubleshooting). Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree or above in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. • 3 or more years of hardware development experience • Experience with analog and digital circuit design, including power supply, signal conditioning, communication interfaces, and protection circuits. • Experience with integration of electronics into machines, including grounding, shielding, earthing, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) is a plus. • Proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design tools, preferably Altium Designer. • Good English reading, writing, and verbal communication skills for international collaboration and technical documentation. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案

Aufgaben:
• 设备设计与改造：负责非标设备及标准设备的方案设计、升级改造与优化，包括方案制定、图纸输出（2D/3D）、BOM及相关技术文档编制，确保设计质量、成本与交付周期满足项目要求。

• 需求沟通与技术方案：对接客户或内部项目团队，进行需求澄清与技术评估，输出可行性分析与技术解决方案，支持项目立项与方案决策。

• 新系统开发与产品化推进：独立负责新系统（由多个单元设备组成）的开发全流程，包括前期市场/应用调研、系统方案与详细设计、样机制造与测试验证、问题闭环，以及后续产品化与市场推广的技术支持。

• 生产制造支持：与生产/供应链团队协同，解决加工装配、工艺实现与现场异常问题，推动问题快速闭环并持续改进可制造性。

• 调试测试与性能优化：参与设备现场调试、功能/性能测试与优化改进，确保设备稳定性、可靠性及关键指标达到验收标准。

• 售后技术支持与问题处理：响应设备使用过程中的技术问题，提供远程/现场支持，定位根因并提出整改措施，必要时推动设计迭代与经验沉淀。

• 技术文件体系建设：编制并维护技术规范书、操作/维护手册、调试指导书、验收文件等技术资料，确保版本受控与交付完整。

• 跨部门技术支撑：支持销售/项目交付等团队的技术工作（如方案支持、技术澄清、投标/报价技术输入等），提升项目成功率与客户满意度。

Anforderungen:
• 大学本科或研究生学历， 机械设计制造及自动化专业和机械设计相关专业。

• 具备撬装设备设计经验，熟悉模块化/成套设备架构与集成设计，能够完成机械、电气、仪表/控制等多专业接口协调与系统集成。

• 5年以上机械设计相关经验，涵盖非标设备设计、自动化装备开发或产品研发，具备从方案到落地的完整项目经验。

• 具备独立主导设计/开发能力，独立完成并成功交付项目/案例不少于 5 个（含方案设计、详细设计、制造配合、调试验证及问题闭环）。

• 专业能力与创新：具备扎实的机械设计专业基础，能够在满足安全、质量、成本与交付的前提下持续优化方案，具备良好的创新意识与工程化落地能力。

• 设计方法与工具：熟悉机械设计原理及常用工程计算/选型方法，熟练使用 CAD 2D/3D 设计工具（如 Inventor、SolidWorks 等），可独立完成建模、工程图、BOM输出及设计变更管理。

• 英语能力：具备良好的英语听说读写能力，能够进行技术资料阅读与编写，并可参与英文技术沟通、会议交流与邮件往来。

• 团队协作与沟通：具备良好的团队合作意识，沟通开放透明，能够高效进行跨部门协调与资源推动。

• 独立推进与问题解决：可独立承担设备设计任务，具备较强的创新意识、系统分析能力与问题闭环能力，能快速定位关键矛盾并提出可实施方案。

• 责任感与抗压能力：责任心强，目标导向，在多任务与交付压力下仍能保持工作质量与进度可控。

Wir streben danach, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der Wissenschaft zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Professionnel du service client axé sur les ventes pour développer les activités après-vente de Bühler en Thaïlande pour la nutrition humaine et animale. Ce rôle pilotera les ventes de services, développera les relations avec les clients et convertira les opportunités en commandes, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de vente et de service.

Aufgaben:
• Atteindre les objectifs de ventes (commandes, chiffre d'affaires, marge, pipeline).

• Identifier, développer et clôturer les opportunités de service client.

• Développez votre activité de services en matière de pièces de rechange, de contrats de service, de rénovations, de mises à niveau et de services sur le terrain.

• Établir des relations solides avec les clients et comprendre leurs besoins opérationnels.

• Traduire les défis des clients (par exemple, temps d'arrêt, efficacité, qualité, coût) en solutions.

• Gérer le pipeline des ventes, les devis et les prévisions à l'aide des outils CRM.

• Générez des revenus récurrents grâce à des contrats de service et des accords à long terme.

• Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour proposer des propositions compétitives.

• Fournir des informations sur le marché sur les besoins des clients, les concurrents et les prix.

Réponses :
• Diplôme/diplôme en ingénierie, en commerce ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans le service, le marché secondaire ou la vente technique.

• Expérience avérée en ventes et en gestion de la relation client.

• Expérience en machines, pièces de rechange ou solutions industrielles préférée.

• Maîtrise du thaï et de l'anglais.

• La connaissance des outils de vente CRM et numériques/IA est un plus.

• La connaissance des industries de transformation de l'alimentation humaine et animale est un avantage.

Deux milliards de personnes consomment chaque jour des aliments produits avec les équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines.
Bühler vise à équilibrer l’humanité, la nature et l’économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les secteurs mondiaux de l’alimentation humaine et animale et de la mobilité.
Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C’est pourquoi nous faisons équipe avec des clients, des start-ups, des multinationales et des universitaires pour accélérer ensemble notre impact.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Buhler Group in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia is looking for a passionate Project Engineer to support customers with project execution, installation, commissioning, maintenance, and optimization of Bühler machines and systems. This role is responsible for coordinating projects from handover through completion, ensuring timely and cost-effective execution while managing technical requirements, subcontractors, customer expectations, documentation, and project risks.

Aufgaben:
• Take ownership of assigned projects following handover from Sales, Customer Service, or Order Management.

• Review contracts, quotations, technical specifications, scope of supply, commercial conditions, exclusions, responsibilities, and project risks.

• Develop and maintain project execution plans covering engineering, procurement, logistics, installation, commissioning, and handover.

• Define and monitor project milestones, deliverables, timelines, resources, and dependencies.

• Coordinate project activities from order confirmation through customer acceptance and project closure.

• Monitor project progress, costs, schedules, deliveries, and contractual obligations, taking corrective action when required.

• Ensure project deliverables meet contractual requirements, Bühler standards, safety requirements, and customer expectations.

• Coordinate internal and external project meetings and ensure timely follow-up of actions.

• Maintain accurate and complete project documentation.

• Coordinate customers, internal teams, subcontractors, and service providers to ensure smooth project execution.

• Support the selection, qualification, onboarding, and performance management of subcontractors and service providers.

• Prepare and/or review scopes of work and coordinate subcontractor mobilization, including site access, permits, tools, equipment, and resources.

• Support project budgeting, cost control, invoicing, and payment milestone tracking.

• Identify and manage technical, commercial, schedule, quality, and site risks.

• Identify potential service, upgrade, and modernization opportunities based on customer requirements.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Approximately 3–5 years of experience in project engineering, service projects, installation, commissioning, maintenance, or industrial project execution.

• Experience coordinating subcontractors and site contractors.

• Experience managing project schedules, milestones, costs, deliveries, and contractual requirements.

• Experience in industrial equipment, food processing, grain handling, milling, feed, consumer foods, manufacturing, or a related industry is an advantage.

• Experience with service contracts or preventive-maintenance agreements is an advantage.

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, technical specifications, and equipment documentation.

• Understanding of installation, commissioning, maintenance, and industrial service processes.

• Basic knowledge of project budgeting, cost control, invoicing, and payment milestones.

• Knowledge of site safety requirements, risk assessments, method statements, and permit-to-work systems.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project-scheduling tools; familiarity with ERP, CRM, and project-management systems is an advantage.

• Fluency in Arabic and English, both written and spoken.

• Project management training or certification is an advantage.

• Strong project planning and execution skills.

• Effective coordination and stakeholder management.

• Customer-focused mindset with strong communication skills.

• Analytical and problem-solving ability.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Applicare ora con i documenti di applicazione completi (lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati) e iniziare il tuo futuro con noi! Compiti:
• Si automatizzano macchine e impianti e ottimizzare i loro processi
• Pianifica e crea documenti elettrici e concetti di controllo
• Costruisci i controlli elettrici e assembla i componenti corrispondenti
• Si programma software e creare visualizzazioni per sistemi automatizzati
• Provare gli impianti, metterli in funzione e lavorare su progetti entusiasmanti nel campo della scienza informatica e dell'automazione Requisiti
• Interessi in nuove tecnologie, ingegneria elettrica e contesti tecnici
• Artigianato
• Pazienza, perseveranza e concentrazione
• Lavoro autonomo
• Lavoro di squadra Offriamo: Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Apply now with your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) and start your future with us! For more than 150 years, we have been developing innovative solutions for the coating of architectural glass, spectacle lenses and optical components for smartphones, vehicles and medical technology.

As an employee (m/f/d) Sales Interior Service / Sales Support, you support the sales team and divisional management with offers, calculations and project documents. With your structured working method, you ensure efficient processes and accompany international customer projects administratively. Become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They create, revise and verify the plausibility of calculations and offers for international plant projects. • They bring together information and requirements from our worldwide sales and specialist areas in a structured manner and create a reliable supply basis. • They support our customers worldwide during the offer process and are at their disposal as a competent contact person. • You coordinate the internal coordination with engineering, purchasing, project management and service and thus support the sales team in the preparation of the offer. • They ensure complete and proper project budgeting. • You take on administrative and organizational tasks in the Sales Back Office and support the department management in evaluations, presentations and reports. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Bühler Leybold Optics, qui fait partie du groupe Bühler, est l'un des leaders du marché des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous développons des solutions innovantes pour le revêtement du verre architectural, des verres de spectacle et des composants optiques pour smartphones, véhicules et technologies médicales.

En tant qu'employé (m/f/d) Service d'intérieur des ventes / Soutien aux ventes, vous aidez l'équipe de vente et la direction divisionnaire avec des offres, des calculs et des documents de projet. Avec votre méthode de travail structurée, vous assurez l'efficacité des processus et accompagnez les projets clients internationaux administrativement. Devenez membre de Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Faisons la différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Exigences • Ils ont suivi une formation commerciale ou technique, idéalement complétée par une formation continue en tant que technicien, économiste d'entreprise ou une qualification comparable. • Vous apportez votre première expérience professionnelle en support commercial, service interne de vente, dans la préparation d'offres ou dans une fonction comparable. • Idéalement, vous avez déjà travaillé avec des outils de devis, de calcul, de CRM ou de configuration de produits et avez une bonne compréhension technique et commerciale. • Vous êtes sûr de traiter avec MS Office; Connaissance du SAP est un avantage. • Grâce à vos bonnes compétences en langue anglaise, vous pouvez communiquer en toute sécurité avec des clients internationaux ainsi qu'avec des domaines de vente et de spécialisation dans le monde entier. • Une façon systématique, structurée et prudente de travailler ainsi que de solides compétences en communication et en coordination vous distinguent. • Initiative, fiabilité, travail d'équipe et plaisir de travailler ensemble dans un environnement international complètent votre profil. Nous offrons: Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail d'opportunités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles. Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons fêter ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour stimuler votre productivité et votre innovation. Culture des entreprises familiales Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme – dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. Avantages sociaux et rabais Profitez d'une variété d'avantages sociaux et de réductions qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne. Faites partie de notre équipe et en savoir plus. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits dans les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

• Desarrollar layouts, vistas, cortes, detalles constructivos y planos de montaje.

Our Competence Center Leipzig specializes in high-precision surface polishing using ion beam and plasma processing processes in the sub-nanometer area. We also develop optical measurement systems and implement sophisticated automation and robot solutions.

As a development engineer (m/f/d) you become part of an interdisciplinary team that solves technical challenges with creativity and innovation. They work on key components for high-end systems and accompany developments from the idea to series production.

If you enjoy developing complex technical solutions and helping to shape them in a dynamic environment, we look forward to meeting you.

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks: In this versatile position, you take responsibility for the development of sophisticated technical solutions and work closely with internal and external partners.

Their tasks include in particular:

• Development of concepts and technical solutions for the new and further development of key components of our high-end systems

• Monitoring the implementation of development projects to production-ready products

• Preparation and maintenance of technical documentation, including in the areas of mechanical design, circuit diagram design and circuit board routing

• Planning, implementation and evaluation of laboratory tests for verifying new developments

• Close cooperation and technical coordination with internal departments and external customers

• Support for assembly, integration and commissioning of high-precision measuring systems

• Selection of suitable components as well as communication and coordination with suppliers

• Active cooperation in a cross-functional team with plenty of room for own ideas and technical design

Requirements: For this position we are looking for a technically enthusiastic personality who likes to work solution-oriented and enjoys demanding development tasks.

You bring with you:

• Successfully completed studies in the fields of mechatronics, laser and optotechnology, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable qualification

• Safe handling of technical data sheets, specifications and documentation

• Initial knowledge of electronics development, for example with Autodesk Eagle, and mechanical design, for example with Solid Edge

• Programming skills in C++ or Python are advantageous

• Good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

• Structured, responsible and independent working methods

• Team spirit, communication strength and joy in developing innovative solutions together

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

In questa posizione, si assume la responsabilità generale delle risorse umane per le sedi di Bühler in Austria, Germania, Danimarca e Paesi Bassi.

A Bühler facciamo la differenza: ogni giorno due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto sulle piante di Bühler; un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

• Gestione, sviluppo e supporto operativo dei team HR.

• Controllo e ottimizzazione delle attività di gestione dei talenti, delle prestazioni e delle concentrazioni.

• Sostegno e coaching dei dirigenti e dei dipendenti nei processi di cambiamento e moderazione dei workshop interni.

• Garantire il rispetto del diritto del lavoro e dei contatti con i consigli di fabbrica.

• Ulteriore sviluppo di una strategia di branding e reclutamento dei dipendenti sostenibile e moderna.

• Molti anni di esperienza come responsabile delle risorse umane, o in una posizione di gestione comparabile con esperienza / comprensione per le strutture aziendali.

• Formazione completa (università o FH) preferibilmente con un focus sul capitale umano.

• esperienza nel controllo e nel monitoraggio dei processi di cambiamento e dei progetti HR.

• Conoscenza molto buona del diritto del lavoro e sociale austriaco.

• Metodi di lavoro strutturati, decisionali e di attuazione, accompagnati da un atteggiamento professionale e vincente.

• Comunicazione, moderazione e consultazione piacere su un piano di parità in tedesco e in inglese.

• Atteggiamento ottimale, pensiero strategico, mentalità pragmatica

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• Management, development and operational support of HR teams.

• Control and optimization of the activities in talent, performance & concentration management.

• Support and coaching of managers and employees in change processes and moderation of internal workshops.

• Ensure compliance with labour law and contact persons for works councils.

• Further development of a sustainable, modern employee branding and recruiting strategy.

descriptionByLocale.it:

La posizione riveste un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione di strutture commerciali, nel garantire l'eccellenza operativa e nel garantire il successo del cliente attraverso forti partnership contrattuali.

Aufgaben:
• Prendere la piena proprietà del portafoglio assegnato di accordi di servizio (ad esempio, Servizi Remoti, Ispezione e Manutenzione), garantendo l'eccellenza di consegna e l'alta soddisfazione del cliente.

• Sviluppare e condurre una struttura di sostegno regionale, compresa la gestione delle quotazioni, la consegna dei contratti e le operazioni di back-office.

• Agire come punto di contatto principale per tutte le questioni di servizio contrattuale, assicurando l'esecuzione tempestiva ed efficace allineata alle aspettative del cliente.

• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con i team Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts e Automation per fornire soluzioni di servizio integrate.

• Guidare l'eccellenza operativa e la standardizzazione della gestione degli accordi di servizio in tutta la regione di SEA.

• Superare i processi di rinnovo del contratto, le strategie di prezzi e le misure di controllo dei costi per mantenere la redditività.

• Sviluppare e presentare proposte di servizio integrate che bilanciano le esigenze del cliente con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Sostenere l'identificazione, lo sviluppo, la citazione e la negoziazione di accordi di servizio complessi.

• Stabilire e mantenere modelli di calcolo dei costi specifici della regione in allineamento con le linee guida globali.

• Lavora con team tecnici, legali, finanziari e commerciali per garantire proposte accurate, conformi e competitive.

• Mantenere la documentazione completa di citazioni, contratti e processi di consegna.

• Comunicare proattivamente con le parti interessate sullo stato della proposta, sugli aggiornamenti dei prezzi e sui progressi dell'esecuzione dei contratti.

• Collabora con i team globali per condividere approfondimenti e migliorare continuamente le offerte di assistenza e l'esperienza dei clienti.

• Sostenere l'attuazione di strutture di servizio, processi, strumenti e migliori pratiche all'interno della regione

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in Business Administration, Ingegneria, o un campo relativo.

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali di vendita o front-end.

• Forte comprensione delle strategie di manutenzione e metodologie di pianificazione.

• Solida acume commerciale, compresi i prezzi, la gestione dei costi e la valutazione del rischio.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di presentazione.

• Fluenza in inglese (scritta e parlata).

• Auto-motivato con una forte mentalità imprenditoriale e approccio guidato dai risultati.

• Capacità di operare efficacemente all'interno di un'organizzazione matrice in più paesi e unità aziendali.

• Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senza autorità diretta.

Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Le poste joue un rôle essentiel dans la définition des structures commerciales, la garantie de l'excellence opérationnelle et la réussite du client grâce à de solides partenariats contractuels.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Nell'ambito del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei leader di mercato nel campo dei sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto a film sottili ad alta tecnologia. Il nostro Centro di competenza di Lipsia è specializzato nella lucidatura superficiale utilizzando processi di lavorazione dei raggi ionici e del plasma nell'area sub-nanometro. Il nostro team produce anche sistemi di misurazione ottica ad alta precisione ed è esperto in automazione e programmazione robotica.

Come stagista/studente presso lo stabilimento (m/p/d) nell'area della pianificazione e del controllo della produzione, supporti il nostro team a Lipsia sia nell'implementazione che nell'ottimizzazione dei processi nel campo dell'approvvigionamento, della pianificazione produttiva e della logistica. Siete comunicativi, affidabili e non titieni lontano dall'assumere compiti indipendentemente? Allora applicatevi ora e entrate a far parte del nostro team.

Facciamo la differenza a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto sulle piante di Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler mira a conciliare le esigenze di business, persone e natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità commerciali sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Compiti:
• Siete responsabili della pianificazione, controllo e monitoraggio dei nostri ordini di produzione e garantire che i materiali, le capacità e le scadenze siano coordinati in modo ottimale.

• Analizza la produzione, il materiale e i dati master nei sistemi ERP e PDM e sviluppa continuamente la nostra pianificazione predittiva della produzione e della domanda.

• Contribuisci attivamente ad ottimizzare ed espandere processi e strutture nelle interfacce tra pianificazione della produzione, preparazione del lavoro, approvvigionamento e logistica.

• Sostieni il business giornaliero operativo della pianificazione della produzione e lavori a stretto contatto con l'acquisto, la preparazione del lavoro, la logistica e la produzione.

• Contribuisci a un flusso di materiale fluido e coordina la consegna tempestiva del materiale, compreso il prelievo e il riposizionamento.

Requisiti:
• Siete studenti iscritti (m/p/d) nei settori dell'ingegneria industriale, dell'amministrazione aziendale, della gestione logistica, della gestione della catena logistica o in un programma di laurea comparabile.

• Siete sicuri con MS Office e idealmente avete già esperienza iniziale nel trattare con sistemi ERP come SAP o Lexware.

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e inglese in parole e scrittura.

• Ti piace lavorare in un team e convincere con un metodo di lavoro strutturato, attento e affidabile.

• Vi piace pianificare i processi, contribuire a modellare i processi e sviluppare le strutture.

• Siete interessati alla pianificazione della produzione, ai flussi di materiale e al coordinamento delle diverse interfacce in azienda.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti Goditi una varietà di benefici e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la tua vita quotidiana più facile.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. Our Competence Centre Leipzig specializes in surface polishing using ion beam and plasma processing processes in the sub-nanometer area. Our team also manufactures high-precision optical measurement systems and is an expert in automation and robot programming.

As an intern / student at the plant (m/w/d) in the area of production planning and control, you support our team in Leipzig both in the implementation and optimization of processes in the field of procurement, production planning and logistics. You are communicative, reliable and do not shy away from taking on tasks independently? Then apply now and become part of our team.

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler plants. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industry.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You are responsible for the planning, control and monitoring of our manufacturing orders and ensure that materials, capacities and deadlines are optimally coordinated.

• You analyze production, material and master data in ERP and PDM systems and continuously develop our predictive production and demand planning.

• You actively help to optimize and expand processes and structures at the interfaces between production planning, work preparation, procurement and logistics.

• You support the daily operational business of production planning and work closely with purchasing, work preparation, logistics and manufacturing.

• You contribute to a smooth material flow and coordinate the timely material delivery, including picking and repositioning.

Requirements:
• You are a enrolled student (m/w/d) in the fields of industrial engineering, business administration, logistics management, supply chain management or in a comparable degree program.

• You are safe with MS Office and ideally already have initial experience in dealing with ERP systems such as SAP or Lexware.

• You have good knowledge of German and English in word and writing.

• You like to work in a team and convince by a structured, careful and reliable working method.

• You enjoy planning processes, helping to shape processes and developing structures.

• You are interested in production planning, material flows and the coordination of different interfaces in the company.

We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Learning Platform Welcome to a world of over 16,000 opportunities to train!

Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of business, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Bühler Leybold Optics est un groupe d'ingénierie mondial qui emploie plus de 13 000 personnes et qui est l'un des leaders du marché dans le domaine des systèmes de revêtement à vide à film mince de haute technologie. Aufgaben:

• Establish, manage, and maintain current customers and potential customers relationships.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Inizia subito. Progettare domani. BFuture. Sei comunicativo, come organizzare e voler sapere come funziona un'azienda internazionale? Allora l'apprendistato come commerciante / commerciante EFZ (E- o M-profile) a Bühler è giusto per voi! Applicare ora con i documenti di applicazione completi (lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati) e iniziare il tuo futuro con noi! Compiti:
• Si organizzano viaggi, incontri, visite ed eventi in modo efficiente
• Crea documenti professionali in diverse lingue
• Si ordinano beni, materiali e servizi e coordinano la loro gestione
• Si consiglia ai clienti e agli ordini di processo in modo affidabile dall'indagine all'implementazione
• Si crea documenti di esportazione e si assume il supporto dei compiti contabili Requisiti
• Capacità di comunicazione (D/E)
• Buona comprensione
• Capacità organizzativa
• Lavoro autonomo e lavoro di squadra
• pensiero e azione in rete Offriamo: Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Start now. Design tomorrow. BFuture.

You are communicative, like to organize and want to know how an international company works? Then the apprenticeship as a merchant / merchant EFZ (E- or M-profile) at Bühler is just right for you!


Apply now with your complete application documents (motivation letter, CV, certificates) and start your future with us! Tasks: • You organize travel, meetings, visits and events efficiently • You create professional documents in different languages • You order goods, materials and services and coordinate their handling • You advise customers and process orders reliably from inquiry to implementation • You create export documents and take on supporting accounting tasks Requirements • Communication capability (D/E) • Good understanding • Organisational capacity • Self-employment and teamwork • Networked thinking and action We offer: Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Starte jetzt. Gestalte morgen. BFuture.


Du bist kommunikativ, organisierst gerne und möchtest wissen, wie ein internationales Unternehmen funktioniert? Dann ist die Lehrstelle als Kauffrau/Kaufmann EFZ (E- bzw. M-Profil) bei Bühler genau das Richtige für dich!


Bewerbe dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) und starte deine Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben: • Du organisierst Reisen, Meetings, Besuche und Veranstaltungen effizient • Du erstellst professionelle Dokumente in verschiedenen Sprachen • Du bestellst Waren, Materialien und Dienstleistungen und koordinierst deren Abwicklung • Du berätst Kunden und bearbeitest Aufträge zuverlässig von der Anfrage bis zur Umsetzung • Du erstellst Exportdokumente und übernimmst unterstützend buchhalterische Aufgaben Anforderungen: • Kommunikationsfähigkeit (D/E) • Gute Auffassungsgabe • Organisationsfähigkeit • Selbständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit • Vernetztes Denken und Handeln Wir bieten: Attraktiver Ferienanspruch Ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis zu 30 Tage Ferien pro Jahr abhängig vom Lebensjahr. Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept Wir bieten ein OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax für 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV-Guthaben sowie ein attraktives Erstklass-Abonnement oder kostenlose Parkplätze. Personalrestaurant VIVA Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitenden ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF. Handy-Abonnements Wir bieten Spezialkonditionen bei Handyabonnements über Mobilezone bei Sunrise und Swisscom. Health-Port Wir setzen uns für Gesundheitsprävention durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse sowie einen Betriebsarzt ein. Sportangebote Wir fördern die sportliche Betätigung durch eigenorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie durch Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

• Collect and analyze customer feedback to identify service improvement opportunities and new business potential.

• Collaborate with executive management and cross-functional stakeholders to make effective operational and business decisions.

Anforderungen:
• Minimum 3 years of experience managing a plant, facility, or field service organization

• Understanding of engineering, mechanical systems or facility service operation.

• Experience in service business operation s and P&L management

• Proven leadership experience managing field service engineers or technical service teams

• Experience in performance management and business operation within a service or technology-based organization.

• Proven track record of delivering results with strong ownership, responsibility, and execution capability

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Beschreibung Diese Aufgabe ist verantwortlich für die Führung und Optimierung des Kundenservices, einschließlich der Außendiensttechnik, des Leistungsmanagements und der kundenzentrierten Serviceausführung. Diese Aufgabe wird Serviceteams überwachen, die Betriebseffizienz verbessern, Schlüsselservice-KPIs verwalten und das Wachstum von servicebezogenen Geschäftsbereichen wie Außendienst, Ersatzteile, Werkstätten, Dienstleistungsverträge und technische Beratung unterstützen.

Responsibilities - Führen und verwalten Sie das Team des Außendienstingenieurs, um eine effektive Ressourcenallokation und operative Effizienz zu gewährleisten. - Entwickeln und implementieren Sie die Personalstrategien des Kundendienstes, einschließlich Rekrutierung, Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und Aufbau von Fähigkeiten. - Standardisierung und Verbesserung der Servicebetriebsprozesse, um die Ausführungsqualität und Konsistenz zu verbessern. - Unterstützung der Vertriebsaktivitäten durch Ermittlung der Kundenbedürfnisse und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. - Verwalten und verbessern Sie die wichtigsten Kundendienst-KPIs, einschließlich Servicekosten, Ingenieurnutzung, Produktivität und operative Leistung.

- Führen Sie die Profitabilität durch effektives Management von Service-, Werkstatt- und Ersatzteilgeschäften. - Verwalten und priorisieren Sie das Service-Produktportfolio auf der Grundlage von Geschäftsanforderungen, Kundenwert und Wachstumspotenzial. - Entwickeln und ausführen Sie mittelfristige Wachstumsstrategien für das Kundenservicegeschäft. - Analysieren Sie die Bedürfnisse des Kundendienstes und entwickeln Sie Wachstumspläne für Bereiche wie Teile, Außendienst, Serviceverträge und technische Beratung. - Führen Sie Kundenkommunikation während der Projektausführung und Service-Lieferung.

- Sammeln und analysieren Sie Kundenfeedback, um Service-Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und neues Geschäftspotenzial zu identifizieren. - Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, um effektive operative und geschäftliche Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Anforderungen - Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung einer Anlage, Einrichtung oder Außendienstorganisation - Verständnis des Engineerings, mechanischer Systeme oder des Facility Service Betriebs - Erfahrung in Service-Geschäftsbetrieb und P&L Management - Bewährte Führungserfahrung in der Verwaltung von Außendienst-Ingenieuren oder technischen Service-Teams - Erfahrung in Performance Management und Geschäftsbetrieb innerhalb eines Service- oder technologiebasierten Organisation - Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz der Bereitstellung von Ergebnissen mit starker Eigentümerschaft, Verantwortung und Ausführungsfähigkeit

Was wir anbieten - täglich essen zwei Milliarden Menschen Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. - Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. - Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft in jeder Entscheidung zu balancieren, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftschancen in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. - Wir streben Innovationen für eine bessere Welt an, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen.

- Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und Hochschulen zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description Ce rôle est chargé de diriger et d'optimiser les opérations de service à la clientèle, y compris l'ingénierie des services sur le terrain, la gestion du rendement des services et l'exécution des services axés sur la clientèle. Ce rôle supervisera les équipes de services, améliorera l'efficacité des opérations, gérera les ICR de services clés et appuiera la croissance des secteurs d'activité liés aux services tels que les services sur le terrain, les pièces de rechange, les ateliers, les contrats de services et les services consultatifs techniques.

Responsabilités - Diriger et gérer l'équipe d'ingénieurs des services sur le terrain, en assurant une affectation efficace des ressources et une efficacité opérationnelle. - Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de personnel de service à la clientèle, y compris le recrutement, le développement, le déploiement et le renforcement des capacités. - Normaliser et améliorer les processus de fonctionnement des services afin d'améliorer la qualité et l'uniformité de l'exécution. - Appuyer les activités de vente des services en identifiant les besoins des clients et les possibilités d'affaires. - Gérer et améliorer les principaux ICR du service à la clientèle, y compris les coûts de service, l'utilisation des ingénieurs, la productivité et le rendement opérationnel.

- Gérer et prioriser le portefeuille de produits de service en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, de la valeur de la clientèle et du potentiel de croissance. - Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de croissance à moyen et long terme pour l'entreprise de service à la clientèle. - Analyser les besoins de l'entreprise de service à la clientèle et élaborer des plans de croissance dans des domaines comme les pièces, le service sur le terrain, les contrats de services et les services consultatifs techniques.

- Recueillir et analyser les commentaires des clients afin de cerner les possibilités d'amélioration des services et le nouveau potentiel opérationnel. - Collaborer avec la direction et les intervenants interfonctionnels pour prendre des décisions opérationnelles et opérationnelles efficaces.

Exigences - Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans la gestion d'une usine, d'une installation ou d'une organisation de services sur le terrain - Connaissance de l'ingénierie, des systèmes mécaniques ou de l'exploitation de services sur le terrain - Expérience en matière d'exploitation des services et de gestion des P et L - Expérience de leadership dans la gestion des ingénieurs ou des équipes de services techniques sur le terrain - Expérience en gestion du rendement et en opérations commerciales au sein d'une organisation de services ou de technologies - Expérience de la prestation des résultats avec une forte capacité de propriété, de responsabilité et d'exécution

Ce que nous offrons - Deux milliards de personnes mangent des aliments par jour qui ont été produits avec des équipements Bühler. - Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. - Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision, tout en développant des solutions qui permettent de libérer des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. - Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables.

- Nous faisons donc équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Bühler Group is a Swiss, family-owned technology company specializing in food, feed and advanced materials. Every day, around 2 billion people consume food processed with Bühler technologies, while mobility solutions using Bühler technology serve 1 billion people.

This global impact comes with responsibility. Bühler aims to reduce energy, waste and water use by 50% in its customers' value chains. To measure progress, the company has quantified the environmental footprint of key products and assessed how its technologies and services can reduce CO₂ emissions, land use and water consumption.

Bühler offers a six-month internship to further embed this methodology across the business, support customer projects and reduce environmental impacts in both customer and Bühler value chains. You will gain expertise in carbon accounting, value-chain thinking and entrepreneurship. Shape a sustainable future with us. Apply now! Aufgaben: • Drive the environmental quantification project and further embed the methodology across Bühler's businesses. • Contribute to reducing CO₂e emissions in both the Customer Value Chain and the Bühler Value Chain. • Build and expand your expertise in carbon accounting and value-chain thinking. • Develop your entrepreneurial skills within an international company. • Take ownership of the project and collaborate with relevant stakeholders to overcome challenges and deliver meaningful results. Anforderungen: • You are adaptable and comfortable working on a project that requires both interpersonal and technical skills. • You are a quick learner with strong communication and social skills. • You think entrepreneurially and are able to take ownership of the project, identify opportunities, and overcome challenges. • You are trustworthy and demonstrate ownership in line with Bühler's values: Trust, Ownership, and Passion. • You are passionate about Bühler and motivated by the opportunity to advance sustainability across the business. • You have a good command of written and spoken English; good German language skills are an advantage. Wir bieten: Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Mobile phone subscriptions We offer special conditions for cell phone subscriptions via Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei entusiasta dello sviluppo di giovani talenti e vuoi plasmare attivamente il futuro della formazione professionale? In questo versatile ruolo di gestione, si assume il personale e la responsabilità organizzativa per i settori della costruzione e della gestione del progetto all'interno della nostra formazione professionale. Insieme con il Capo dell'Apprendistato, svilupperai concetti di formazione innovativi, creerai condizioni ottimali per gli studenti e i dipendenti e dare un contributo importante alla riuscita attuazione della riforma professionale Futuremem. Unisci leadership, pensiero strategico e un forte orientamento al servizio con una passione per l'istruzione e le professioni tecniche.

Compiti:
• Essi conducono, promuovono e sviluppano i dipendenti nei settori della costruzione e della gestione del progetto e creano un ambiente di lavoro motivante e stimolante.

• Sei responsabile dello sviluppo strategico e organizzativo delle tue aree e partecipa attivamente all'attuazione e allo sviluppo della riforma professionale "Futuremem"

• Essi sviluppano ulteriormente la gestione del progetto come una competenza centrale futura della formazione professionale e coordinano progetti, processi e iniziative transfrontaliere

• Garantiscono la pianificazione e il controllo ottimali del personale, delle risorse, del bilancio, dei centri di costo e delle infrastrutture e creano condizioni quadro economiche e future per la formazione.

• Essi mantengono una stretta collaborazione con i clienti interni, i dipartimenti, le risorse umane e i partner esterni e sostengono la formazione professionale in attività di reclutamento, eventi di orientamento professionale e situazioni difficili con gli studenti

Requisiti
• Completata la formazione professionale tecnica, preferibilmente nel settore della costruzione, dell'ingegneria o di un ambiente tecnico comparabile, integrata da una formazione professionale o aziendale rilevante

• Conoscenza del sistema di formazione professionale svizzero e nel campo della formazione professionale, nonché esperienza e gioia nella promozione dei giovani

• Esperienza di leadership o potenziale comprovato per svolgere una funzione di leadership e la volontà di sottoporsi ad una formazione di leadership appropriata

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nei processi di cambiamento di accompagnamento e una forte comprensione per quanto riguarda lo sviluppo educativo strategico e orientato alle competenze

• Forte capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese

Offriamo:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante personale VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Bühler Pensionskasse offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce un pensionamento finanziario affidabile: www.pk-buhler.ch

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo.

Porta salute
Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you enthusiastic about the development of young talents and would like to actively shape the future of vocational training? In this versatile management role, you assume the personnel and organizational responsibility for the areas of construction and project management within our vocational training. Together with the Head of Apprenticeship, you will develop innovative training concepts, create optimal conditions for learners and employees and make an important contribution to the successful implementation of the professional reform Futuremem. You combine leadership, strategic thinking and a strong service orientation with a passion for education and technical professions.

Tasks:
• They lead, promote and develop employees in the areas of construction and project management and create a motivating and performance-promoting working environment

• You are responsible for the strategic and organizational development of your areas and actively participate in the implementation and further development of the professional reform "Futuremem"

• They further develop project management as a central future competence of vocational training and coordinate cross-divisional projects, processes and initiatives

• They ensure the optimal planning and control of personnel, resources, budget, cost centers and infrastructure and create economic and future-oriented framework conditions for training.

• They maintain close cooperation with internal clients, departments, HR and external partners and support vocational training in recruitment activities, career orientation events and challenging situations with learners

Requirements
• Completed technical vocational training, preferably in the area of construction, engineering or a comparable technical environment, supplemented by relevant higher professional or business education

• Knowledge of the Swiss vocational training system and in the field of vocational training, as well as experience and joy in promoting young people

• Leadership experience or proven potential to perform a leadership function and the willingness to undergo appropriate leadership training

• Experience in project management and in accompanying change processes as well as a strong understanding with regard to strategic and competence-oriented educational development

• Strong communication skills in German and English

We offer:
Attractive holiday entitlement
Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.

Staff restaurant VIVA
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness.

Health port
We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sie begeistern sich für die Entwicklung junger Talente und möchten die Zukunft der Berufsbildung aktiv mitgestalten? In dieser vielseitigen Führungsfunktion übernehmen Sie die personelle und organisatorische Verantwortung für die Bereiche Konstruktion und Projektmanagement innerhalb unserer Berufsbildung. Gemeinsam mit dem Head of Apprenticeship entwickeln Sie innovative Ausbildungskonzepte weiter, schaffen optimale Rahmenbedingungen für Lernende und Mitarbeitende und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung der Berufsreform Futuremem. Dabei verbinden Sie Führungsstärke, strategisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung mit einer Leidenschaft für Bildung und technische Berufe.

Aufgaben:
• Sie führen, fördern und entwickeln die Mitarbeitenden der Bereiche Konstruktion und Projektmanagement und schaffen ein motivierendes sowie leistungsförderndes Arbeitsumfeld

• Sie verantworten die strategische und organisatorische Weiterentwicklung Ihrer Bereiche und wirken aktiv bei der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Berufsreform "Futuremem" mit

• Sie entwickeln das Projektmanagement als zentrale Zukunftskompetenz der Berufsbildung weiter und koordinieren bereichsübergreifende Projekte, Prozesse und Initiativen

• Sie stellen die optimale Planung und Steuerung von Personal, Ressourcen, Budget, Kostenstellen und Infrastruktur sicher und schaffen wirtschaftliche sowie zukunftsorientierte Rahmenbedingungen für die Ausbildung

• Sie pflegen eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Auftraggebern, Fachbereichen, HR und externen Partnern und unterstützen die Berufsbildung bei Rekrutierungsaktivitäten, Berufsorientierungsveranstaltungen und anspruchsvollen Situationen mit Lernenden

Anforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, vorzugsweise im Bereich Konstruktion, Engineering bzw. einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld, ergänzt durch eine relevante höhere fachliche bzw. betriebswirtschaftliche Weiterbildung

Êtes-vous enthousiaste à l'égard du développement des jeunes talents et souhaitez-vous façonner activement l'avenir de la formation professionnelle? Dans ce rôle de gestion polyvalent, vous assumez la responsabilité du personnel et de l'organisation dans les domaines de la construction et de la gestion de projets dans notre formation professionnelle. En collaboration avec le responsable de l'apprentissage, vous développerez des concepts de formation innovants, créerez des conditions optimales pour les apprenants et les employés et apporterez une contribution importante au succès de la réforme professionnelle Futuremem. Vous combinez leadership, pensée stratégique et une forte orientation de service avec une passion pour l'éducation et les professions techniques.

Tâches :
• Ils dirigent, promeuvent et développent les employés dans les domaines de la construction et de la gestion de projets et créent un environnement de travail motivant et favorisant la performance

• Vous êtes responsable du développement stratégique et organisationnel de vos domaines et participez activement à la mise en œuvre et au développement de la réforme professionnelle « Futuremem »

• Ils développent la gestion des projets en tant que compétence centrale future de la formation professionnelle et coordonnent les projets, les processus et les initiatives interdivisions

• Ils assurent une planification et un contrôle optimaux du personnel, des ressources, du budget, des centres de coûts et des infrastructures et créent des conditions-cadres économiques et prospectives pour la formation.

• Ils maintiennent une coopération étroite avec les clients internes, les départements, les RH et les partenaires externes et soutiennent la formation professionnelle dans les activités de recrutement, les activités d'orientation professionnelle et les situations difficiles avec les apprenants

Exigences
• Formation professionnelle technique achevée, de préférence dans le domaine de la construction, de l'ingénierie ou d'un environnement technique comparable, complétée par une formation professionnelle supérieure ou d'entreprise pertinente

• Connaissance du système suisse de formation professionnelle et dans le domaine de la formation professionnelle, expérience et joie dans la promotion des jeunes

• Expérience en leadership ou potentiel prouvé pour exercer une fonction de leadership et volonté de suivre une formation appropriée en leadership

• Expérience de la gestion de projet et des processus de changement qui l'accompagnent, ainsi qu'une bonne compréhension du développement éducatif stratégique et axé sur les compétences

• Fortes compétences en communication en allemand et en anglais

Questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che combina il pensiero strategico con l'esecuzione hands-on. Porterai la struttura, la messa a fuoco e il pensiero fresco a un paesaggio di apprendimento in evoluzione, influenzando allo stesso tempo le parti interessate in un ambiente di matrice complessa senza contare sull'autorità formale. • L'utente guida l'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo delle operazioni di apprendimento, strumenti, reporting, onboarding e iniziative chiave di apprendimento

Anforderungen:
