• Solida comprensione degli approcci di apprendimento moderni, tra cui l'apprendimento digitale, soluzioni AI-enabled, competenze future e attuali tendenze del mercato L&D, con la capacità di applicarli pragmaticamente

In this role, you will shape how learning is understood, designed, and embedded across our global organisation. In this role, you will further develop our lifelong learning strategy, align learning initiatives with business priorities, and translate strategic ideas into practical solutions that create measurable impact. Working closely with the global Learning Community and key stakeholders worldwide, you will ensure that capability development, skills management, and learning excellence support both employee growth and business performance. This is a role for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will bring structure, focus, and fresh thinking to an evolving learning landscape, while influencing stakeholders in a complex matrix environment without relying on formal authority. As a credible sparring partner, you will challenge constructively, build alignment, and help turn learning into a practical and strategic lever for the organisation.

Aufgaben:
• You shape and evolve the global Learning & Development strategy, offering, and lifelong learning culture globally

• You translate business priorities into practical learning solutions, skills frameworks, career paths, and learning journeys

• You partner with our Learning Community, HR and key stakeholder to position learning as a strategic lever for performance and growth

• You drive the implementation and continuous improvement of learning operations, tools, reporting, onboarding, and key learning initiatives

• You lead and develop a small, distributed team, fostering collaboration, clarity, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented way of working

Anforderungen:
• Solid experience in Learning & Development within an international matrix organisation, with a proven ability to design and evolve learning strategies, learning offerings, and skills-based development approaches

• Strong project and programme management experience, with the ability to translate strategic priorities into practical, scalable learning solutions and measurable outcomes

• Confident stakeholder management skills, including the gravitas to engage senior leaders, challenge constructively, and influence without formal authority

• Solid understanding of modern learning approaches, including digital learning, AI-enabled solutions, future skills, and current L&D market trends, with the ability to apply them pragmatically

• Leadership, change management, and transformation experience, including the ability to guide small, distributed teams and embed learning into everyday work and leadership practices

Do you have a soft spot for the administrative handling of export transactions and would you like to assume responsibility in a dynamic environment? Then you are exactly right in our forwarding team in the field of Manufacturing and Logistics. In this versatile function in a dynamic environment, you can independently handle international export and cross-trade transports for machines and plants. You coordinate deliveries from various worldwide production sites and advise sales and project management on Incoterms, transport concepts and customs and document issues.

Tasks:
• They coordinate international deliveries from different production sites, organise multimodal transports and, in particular, manage international transport processes

• They draw up and verify export-, customs- and accreditation-compliant transit and commercial documents

• They collect transport quotes and evaluate them in terms of costs, duration, routing, equipment and possible risks

• You hire freight forwarders, monitor shipping dates and coordinate the entire transport process

• They ensure compliance with all relevant customs, export control, origin and preference requirements and communicate proactively with internal interfaces, international locations and external partners.

Requirements
• Basic commercial training and several years of experience in administrative export processing; Further training in foreign trade or in the forwarding industry is advantageous

• In-depth knowledge of Incoterms, export and customs documentation and international transport, especially in the field of ocean freight

• Safe handling of transport documents, commercial invoices, packing lists and proofs of origin and preferences; Experience with Letters of Credit, project logistics or machine and plant export is an advantage

• Structured, independent and solution-oriented working method as well as strong communication skills and pleasure in working with internal and external partners

• Very good German and English skills in word and writing as well as good MS-Office skills; SAP experience is beneficial

We offer:
Attractive holiday entitlement
Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.

Staff restaurant VIVA
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness.

Health port
We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• Esperienza in un ruolo commerciale rivolto al cliente, come Sales Manager, Senior Customer Relationship Manager o Key Account Manager

• Il know-how tecnico nelle tecnologie di trasformazione e lavorazione industriale, con la capacità di supportare i clienti in complesse discussioni commerciali e tecniche

• Mindset strategico e imprenditoriale combinato con forte acume commerciale e l'esperienza di gestione complessi cicli di vendita e negoziazione

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about growing markets, developing people, and leading sales success in a dynamic international environment? As International Sales Manager Nuts Processing, you will play a key role in driving profitable growth by leading and coaching Customer Relationship Managers, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities. You will work closely with regional sales teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure excellent commercial execution and sustainable business growth in the Nuts Processing segment.

Aufgaben:
• You lead, coach, and develop Customer Relationship Managers to achieve ambitious growth targets and strengthen sales capabilities

• You manage and grow strategic customer relationships while supporting complex sales opportunities, negotiations, and solution development

• You identify new business opportunities, customer segments, and market trends to drive sustainable growth and provide actionable market intelligence

• You collaborate with the Head of Market Segment Nuts, Chocolate & Flavor Creation sales leadership, and internal stakeholders to develop and execute sales strategies

• You ensure sales excellence through effective cross-functional collaboration, technical enablement of the sales team, and high-quality CRM data and reporting

Anforderungen:
• Proven success in technical B2B sales, account management, or business development within capital equipment, process technology, food processing, or related industries

• Experience in a customer-facing commercial role, such as Sales Manager, Senior Customer Relationship Manager or Key Account Manager

• Technical know-how in food processing and industrial processing technologies, with the ability to support customers in complex commercial and technical discussions

• Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset combined with strong commercial acumen and experience managing complex sales cycles and negotiation

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with fluency in English; additional languages (German, Spanish) are an advantage

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für wachsende Märkte, sich entwickelnde Menschen und führenden Verkaufserfolg in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld? Als International Sales Manager Nuts Processing spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung profitablen Wachstums, indem Sie Customer Relationship Manager leiten und coachen, Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten entwickeln. Sie arbeiten eng mit regionalen Vertriebsteams, Kunden und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine hervorragende kommerzielle Umsetzung und ein nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum im Segment Nuts Processing sicherzustellen.

Aufgaben:
• Sie führen, coachen und entwickeln Customer Relationship Manager, um ehrgeizige Wachstumsziele zu erreichen und die Vertriebskapazität zu stärken

• Sie verwalten und erweitern strategische Kundenbeziehungen und unterstützen gleichzeitig komplexe Verkaufschancen, Verhandlungen und Lösungsentwicklung

• Sie identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, Kundensegmente und Markttrends, um nachhaltiges Wachstum voranzutreiben und umsetzbare Marktinformationen zu liefern

• Sie arbeiten mit dem Head of Market Segment Nuts, Chocolate & Flavor Creation Sales Leadership und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen

• Sie sichern Vertriebsexzellenz durch effektive funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, technische Aktivierung des Vertriebsteams und hochwertige CRM-Daten und Reporting

Anforderungen:
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg im technischen B2B-Vertrieb, Account Management oder Geschäftsentwicklung in den Bereichen Investitionsgüter, Prozesstechnologie, Lebensmittelverarbeitung oder verwandte Branchen

• Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten kommerziellen Rolle wie Sales Manager, Senior Customer Relationship Manager oder Key Account Manager

• Technisches Know-how in der Lebensmittelverarbeitung und industriellen Verarbeitungstechnologien, mit der Fähigkeit, Kunden in komplexen kommerziellen und technischen Diskussionen zu unterstützen

• Strategische und unternehmerische Denkweise kombiniert mit starkem Geschäftssinn und Erfahrung beim Management komplexer Verkaufszyklen und Verhandlungen

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und organisatorische Fähigkeiten, mit fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen (Deutsch, Spanisch) sind von Vorteil

Wir bieten:
Attraktive Urlaubsberechtigung
Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr je nach Alter.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten eine OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax-Fahrkarte für CHF 365 + CHF 400 öffentlicher Nahverkehr sowie eine attraktive First-Class-Fahrkarte oder kostenlose Parkplätze an.

VIVA Restaurant
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9.00 CHF.

Arbeitgebergedeckte Altersvorsorge
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet Bühler Mitarbeitern eine unabhängige Pensionskasse, die eine zuverlässige finanzielle Absicherung im Ruhestand gewährleistet: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sportarten
Wir fördern körperliche Aktivität durch selbstorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Gesundheitshafen
Wir engagieren uns für die präventive Gesundheitsversorgung durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse und einen Betriebsarzt.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche erschließen.
Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.

• L'esprit d'entreprise et de stratégie associé à une forte acuité commerciale et à l'expérience dans la gestion de cycles de vente et de négociations complexes

descriptionByLocale.it: Per rafforzare il nostro reparto IT, stiamo cercando un Solution Architect SAP S/4HANA PM & BPT per modellare il futuro della gestione del ciclo di vita degli asset digitali per i nostri clienti B2B globali. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, i team di sviluppo e gli stakeholder aziendali, progetta soluzioni scalabili, sicure e pronte per il futuro che consentono processi di servizio senza soluzione di continuità, dati di asset di alta qualità e risultati eccezionali del servizio clienti. descriptionByLocale.it:
Vuoi progettare strategie di approvvigionamento globali e sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili per una rete di fornitori competitivi insieme ai team internazionali? In qualità di Global Categoria Manager, si assume la responsabilità strategica per i gruppi di prodotti definiti e la loro gestione del portafoglio. Unisci gli obiettivi di approvvigionamento globale con i requisiti per la sostenibilità, la qualità, il costo, la capacità di consegna e la tecnologia e lavori a stretto contatto con le aree specialistiche interne e fornitori strategici.

Compiti:
• Sviluppi e implementi strategie globali per i gruppi merceologici assegnati e gestisci il loro portafoglio lungo gli obiettivi dell’azienda

• Potrai condurre team interfunzionali nella pianificazione e nell'attuazione di progetti di approvvigionamento globale e condurre iniziative di acquisto

• Costruisci relazioni strategiche con fornitori chiave, sviluppali ulteriormente e negozia contratti, prezzi e condizioni

• Analizzare le tendenze del mercato e della tecnologia, sviluppare soluzioni a basso costo e iniziative di azionamento per l'ottimizzazione sostenibile dei costi

• Lavorano a stretto contatto con la ricerca e lo sviluppo, la gestione del ciclo di vita e i team della supply chain, integrano nuove tecnologie e identificano e riducono i rischi globali della supply chain.

Requisiti
• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria, Economia, Gestione della Supply Chain o una zona tematica comparabile

• Da cinque a sette anni di esperienza professionale nell'approvvigionamento, nell'attuazione del progetto, nella produzione o nella ricerca e nello sviluppo, di cui almeno due anni in una funzione orientata a livello globale

• Conoscenza approfondita della gestione del progetto e l'esperienza nella gestione di team interfunzionali e internazionali e la capacità di lavorare in modo strutturato e orientato alla soluzione anche in caso di cambiamenti dei requisiti

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione in tedesco e inglese, almeno al livello B2, così come la sicurezza in scambio con diversi livelli di organizzazione

• Volontà di viaggiare a livello nazionale e internazionale fino al 20%

Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF.

Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.

Porta salute
Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Attraente diritto di vacanza
Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Bühler Pensionskasse offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce un pensionamento finanziario affidabile: www.pk-buhler.ch

Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom.

Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you want to design global procurement strategies and develop sustainable solutions for a competitive supplier network together with international teams? As a Global Category Manager, you assume strategic responsibility for defined product groups and their portfolio management. You combine global procurement goals with the requirements for sustainability, quality, cost, delivery capability and technology and work closely with internal specialist areas as well as strategic suppliers.

Tasks:
• You develop and implement global strategies for the assigned commodity groups and manage their portfolio along the company’s goals

• You will lead cross-functional teams in planning and implementing global procurement projects and lead buying initiatives

• You build strategic relationships with key suppliers, develop them further and negotiate contracts, prices and conditions

• Analyze market and technology trends, develop cost-efficient solutions and drive initiatives for sustainable cost optimization

• They work closely with research and development, lifecycle management and supply chain teams, integrate new technologies and identify and reduce global supply chain risks.

Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain Management or a comparable subject area

• Five to seven years of professional experience in procurement, project implementation, production or research and development, of which at least two years in a globally oriented function

• In-depth project management knowledge as well as experience in the management of cross-functional and international teams and the ability to work in a structured and solution-oriented manner even in the event of changing requirements

• Very good communication and negotiation skills in German and English, at least at level B2, as well as security in exchange with different levels of organization

• Willingness to travel nationally and internationally up to 20%

We offer:
Staff restaurant VIVA
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.

Health port
We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Attractive holiday entitlement
Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life.

Employer-funded pension plan
Bühler Pensionskasse offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Mobile subscriptions
We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom.

We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

titleByLocale.it: Gestore del team di assistenza sul campo

descriptionByLocale.it:
In questo ruolo potrai guidare e supportare un team regionale di professionisti del servizio sul campo che installa, mantiene e risolve i problemi delle attrezzature per i clienti. Il tuo obiettivo è aiutare il tuo team a lavorare in modo sicuro, fornire risultati di alta qualità e creare una grande esperienza per i clienti dall'inizio alla fine. Potrai impostare chiare aspettative, coach membri del team e garantire che il lavoro di servizio sia completato in modo efficiente e redditizio. Ti unirai strettamente con i clienti per capire le loro esigenze, risolvere i problemi rapidamente e garantire che ogni progetto soddisfi gli standard di qualità e sicurezza aziendali.

In definitiva, sei responsabile del successo di tutte le attività di servizio sul campo all'interno della tua area di business assegnata, mentre costruisci un team qualificato, motivato e orientato al cliente.

Aufgaben:

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role you will lead and support a regional team of field service professionals who install, maintain, and troubleshoot customer equipment. Your focus is on helping your team work safely, deliver high‑quality results, and create a great experience for customers from start to finish.
You'll set clear expectations, coach team members, and ensure service work is completed efficiently and profitably. You'll partner closely with customers to understand their needs, resolve issues quickly, and ensure every project meets company quality and safety standards. Ultimately, you are responsible for the success of all field service activities within your assigned business area, while building a skilled, motivated, and customer‑focused team. Aufgaben: • Recruit, onboard, develop, and performance-manage Field Service Engineers (FSEs) using clear goals, IDPs, the Skills Matrix, and SuccessFactors/EPM+. • Upskill FSEs in mechanical/electronic competencies, market needs, documentation quality, customer communication, and professional reporting; conduct post‑job reviews. • Foster a safety‑first, continuous improvement culture aligned with Bühler values, enforcing all EHS/OSHA/LOTO standards and ensuring timely training and incident reporting. • Maintain deep technical curiosity and build strong working knowledge of the Bühler product portfolio, equipment, and processes. • Plan, assign, and optimize field resources to meet customer timelines, commissioning milestones, repairs, overhauls, and preventive maintenance schedules. • Review job scopes, confirm tool/parts readiness, and monitor job progress while managing escalations and complex troubleshooting with BU, Engineering, Quality, and Remote Support. • Ensure timely, professional communication with all internal and external stakeholders, taking full ownership of customer requests and escalations through closure. • Coordinate service support for project managers and ensure proper costing, accurate quotations, and timely approval of timesheets/expenses. • Manage team utilization, schedule adherence, warranty cost control, and travel/expense discipline aligned with financial goals. • Drive first‑time‑fix rates, job quality, KPI achievement, and identification of service sales opportunities (upgrades, PM contracts, training, parts). • Leverage SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM, and reporting tools to guide decisions, recommend improvements, and support SQCDP/continuous improvement efforts. Anforderungen: • 5+ years in people leadership or technical lead capacity is required. • 5+ years in industrial field service (installation, commissioning, troubleshooting) is preferred. • Strong mechanical and industrial knowledge. • Demonstrated customer facing communication skills and conflict resolution. • Prior leadership/management role. • Formal leadership training. • Microsoft Office is required. • SAP experience is preferred. • Experience with food processing equipment (e.g., pasta, grain, milling, mixing, conveying, thermal, or sorting systems) is preferred. • Ownership & Judgment: Prioritizes safety and quality; makes data backed decisions under time pressure. • Coaching Mindset: Develops talent through feedback, on the job training, and structured learning paths. • Customer Centricity: Anticipates needs; communicates proactively; manages expectations. • Collaboration: Works across Product Lines, Engineering, Quality, and Sales to solve problems. • Continuous Improvement: Challenges the status quo; standardizes and shares best practices. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
In dieser Funktion führen und unterstützen Sie ein regionales Team von Außendienstmitarbeitern, die Kundenausrüstung installieren, warten und beheben. Ihr Fokus liegt auf der sicheren Zusammenarbeit mit Ihrem Team, der Bereitstellung hochwertiger Ergebnisse und der Schaffung von großartigen Erfahrungen für Kunden von Anfang bis Ende. Sie setzen klare Erwartungen, coachen Teammitglieder und gewährleisten, dass die Servicearbeit effizient und profitabel abgeschlossen wird. Sie werden eng mit Kunden zusammenarbeiten, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, Probleme schnell zu lösen und sicherzustellen, dass jedes Projekt den Qualitätsstandards und Sicherheitsstandards des Unternehmens entspricht.

Letztlich sind Sie für den Erfolg aller Feldserviceaktivitäten innerhalb Ihres zugewiesenen Geschäftsfeldes verantwortlich, während Sie ein qualifiziertes, motiviertes und kundenorientiertes Team aufbauen.

• Recruit, onboard, develop und performance-manage Field Service Engineers (FSEs) mit klaren Zielen, IDPs, der Skills Matrix und SuccessFactors/EPM+.

• Verbesserung der FSE in mechanischen/elektronischen Kompetenzen, Marktbedürfnissen, Dokumentationsqualität, Kundenkommunikation und professionellem Reporting; Durchführung von Nachprüfungen.

• Förderung einer Sicherheits-ersten, kontinuierlichen Verbesserungskultur, die auf Bühler-Werte ausgerichtet ist, Durchsetzung aller EHS/OSHA/LOTO-Standards und Gewährleistung einer zeitnahen Schulung und Ereignisberichterstattung.

• Erhalten Sie tiefe technische Neugier und bauen Sie starke Arbeitskenntnisse über das Bühler Produktportfolio, die Ausrüstung und die Prozesse auf.

• Planen, Zuweisen und optimieren Sie die Feldressourcen, um Kunden-Zeitlinien, Inbetriebnahme Meilensteine, Reparaturen, Überholungen und vorbeugende Wartungspläne zu erfüllen.

• Überprüfung der Aufgabenbereiche, Bestätigung der Bereitschaft des Werkzeugs/Teils und Überwachung des Arbeitsfortschritts bei gleichzeitiger Verwaltung von Eskalationen und komplexer Fehlerbehebung mit BU, Engineering, Qualität und Remote Support.

• Gewährleistung einer zeitnahen, professionellen Kommunikation mit allen internen und externen Akteuren, wobei die Kundenwünsche und Eskalationen durch Schließung vollständig in die Hand genommen werden.

• Koordinierung der Service-Unterstützung für Projektmanager und Gewährleistung einer korrekten Kostenrechnung, präzisen Zitaten und rechtzeitiger Genehmigung von Zeitplänen/Expenses.

• Verwalten Sie die Teamauslastung, die Terminbindung, die Kostenkontrolle und die Reise-/Aufwendungsdisziplin, die mit finanziellen Zielen ausgerichtet ist.

• Erstmalige Fixierung, Arbeitsplatzqualität, Leistungserbringung durch KPI und Ermittlung von Service-Verkäufen (Upgrades, PM-Verträge, Schulungen, Teile).

• Leverage SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM und Reporting Tools, um Entscheidungen zu leiten, Verbesserungen zu empfehlen und SQCDP/kontinuierliche Verbesserungsbemühungen zu unterstützen.

• 5+ Jahre in Menschen Führung oder technische Führungskapazität erforderlich ist.

• 5+ Jahre im industriellen Außendienst (Abschaltung, Inbetriebnahme, Fehlerbehebung) werden bevorzugt.

• Starkes mechanisches und industrielles Wissen.

• Vorgestellte Kunden mit Kommunikationskompetenzen und Konfliktlösung.

• Führungs- und Führungsrolle.

• Ausbildung zur Formal Leadership.

• Microsoft Office ist erforderlich.

• SAP-Erfahrung wird bevorzugt.

• Bevorzugt werden Erfahrungen mit Lebensmittelverarbeitungsanlagen (z.B. Teigwaren, Getreide, Fräsen, Mischen, Fördern, thermische oder Sortiersysteme).

• Eigentum & Urteil: Prioritizes Sicherheit und Qualität; trifft Daten gesichert Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck.

• Coaching Mindset: Entwickelt Talente durch Feedback, über die Ausbildung und strukturierte Lernwege.

• Kundenzentrizität: erwartet Bedürfnisse; kommuniziert proaktiv; managt Erwartungen.

• Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten über Produktlinien, Engineering, Qualität und Vertrieb, um Probleme zu lösen.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Herausforderungen des Status Quo; Standardisierung und gemeinsame Nutzung bewährter Verfahren.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft in jeder Entscheidung zu balancieren, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftschancen in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche erschließen. Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und Hochschulen zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et accompagnerez une équipe régionale de professionnels des services sur le terrain qui installent, maintiennent et dépannent l'équipement client. Votre objectif est d'aider votre équipe à travailler en toute sécurité, à fournir des résultats de haute qualité et à créer une expérience formidable pour les clients du début à la fin. Vous fixerez des attentes claires, les membres de l'équipe d'entraîneurs et vous assurerez que le travail de service est terminé de façon efficiente et rentable.

En fin de compte, vous êtes responsable du succès de toutes les activités de service sur le terrain dans votre secteur d'activité, tout en créant une équipe compétente, motivée et axée sur la clientèle.

Aufgaben:
• Recruter, à bord, développer et gérer les ingénieurs des services opérationnels (ESF) en utilisant des objectifs clairs, les personnes déplacées, la matrice des compétences et les facteurs de réussite/EMP+.

• Maintenir une profonde curiosité technique et renforcer les connaissances pratiques du portefeuille de produits, des équipements et des processus Bühler.

• Planifier, affecter et optimiser les ressources sur le terrain pour respecter les délais des clients, les étapes de mise en service, les réparations, les révisions et les calendriers d'entretien préventif.

• Assurer une communication professionnelle et en temps voulu avec toutes les parties prenantes internes et externes, en prenant pleinement en charge les demandes des clients et les escalades par la fermeture.

• Coordonner l'appui aux gestionnaires de projet et veiller à ce que les coûts soient correctement établis, à ce que les devis soient exacts et à ce que les feuilles de temps/dépenses soient approuvées en temps opportun.

• Gérer l'utilisation de l'équipe, l'observation des calendriers, le contrôle des coûts de garantie et la discipline des déplacements/dépenses alignée sur les objectifs financiers.

• Conduire les taux de première fixation, la qualité de l'emploi, la réalisation de l'ICP et l'identification des possibilités de vente de services (mises à niveau, contrats de PM, formation, pièces).

• Leverage SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM et outils de rapport pour guider les décisions, recommander des améliorations et soutenir les efforts d'amélioration continue du PSCQ.

Anforderungen:
• 5 ans et plus de leadership ou de capacité de leadership technique est nécessaire.

• 5 ans et plus en service industriel (installation, mise en service, dépannage) est préféré.

• Forte connaissance mécanique et industrielle.

• Compétences de communication et résolution de conflits démontrées par les clients.

• Rôle préalable de direction/gestion.

• Formation officielle au leadership.

• Microsoft Office est nécessaire.

• L'expérience SAP est privilégiée.

• L'expérience avec les équipements de transformation des aliments (p. ex., les pâtes, les céréales, le fraisage, le mélange, le transport, les systèmes thermiques ou de tri) est privilégiée.

• Propriété & jugement: Prioritaire sécurité et qualité; prend des décisions sur les données sous pression temporelle.

• Coaching Mindset: développe les talents par la rétroaction, sur la formation professionnelle et les voies d'apprentissage structurées.

• Centricity client : Anticiper les besoins; communiquer de façon proactive; gérer les attentes.

• Collaboration : Travaille sur les lignes de produits, l'ingénierie, la qualité et les ventes pour résoudre les problèmes.

• Amélioration continue : défie le statu quo; standardise et partage les meilleures pratiques.

Chaque jour, deux milliards de personnes consomment des aliments produits avec des équipements Bühler. As a Process Engineer (Quotation & Project Execution), you will play a key role in designing and defining process and plant concepts, ensuring technical excellence and high-quality standards throughout the entire project lifecycle. Acting as a vital link between Sales, Quotation, Project Execution, R&D, market segment leaders, international hubs, and customers, you will contribute to the successful delivery of innovative solutions that create lasting value for our customers.

Aufgaben:
• You develop and calculate process solutions during sales and quotation phases ranging from individual machines to complete plant concepts, including process flow diagrams, design bases, technical specifications, and the application of quality principles

• You work on different customer projects during the quotation phase and take an active role during the entire project execution phases, ensuring technical excellence, stakeholder alignment, compliance with deadlines, and cost transparency

• You transform customer requirements into technically sound and value-driven process concepts while providing active expert support to Sales, Quotation, and Project Execution teams

• You take ownership of a dedicated market segment within our Business Area Human Nutrition, managing technical risks, deviations, change requests, and supporting commissioning (mainly back-office), customer trials, and product development activities

• You drive continuous improvement by enhancing workflows, maintaining high-quality documentation and data standards, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and ensuring systematic feedback of product and performance data into internal knowledge bases

Anforderungen:
• Master's degree in Food/Process Technology or Process Engineering, or a comparable qualification with a focus on grain processing (e.g. Swiss Milling School, Swiss Institute of Feed Technology, Deutsche Müller Schule Braunschweig)

• Practical experience in grain processing, including process design, technology, calculations, and/or commissioning activities

• Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills combined with a structured, pragmatic, and results-oriented approach

• Proficiency in MS Office; basic CAD knowledge and additional language skills (e.g., Spanish, French, or Italian) are considered an advantage

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in international and multidisciplinary environments; fluent in German and English

Come Sales Account Manager, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nell'aiutare i clienti a trovare la giusta ottica di precisione e soluzioni optoelettroniche di rivestimento del vuoto per le loro esigenze. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Du stellst Werkstücke und Baugruppen für Maschinen und Produktionsanlagen her und unterstützt bei der Montage, Inbetriebnahme sowie Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten. Du durchläufst unterschiedliche Abteilungen (Montage, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Qualitätsmanagement) und befasst dich mit den Themen Fehleranalyse, Arbeitssicherheit und Qualitätskontrolle. Anforderungen: Du hast mindestens einen guten Hauptschulabschluss mit guten Noten in Mathematik und Physik. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team der kaufmännischen Auftragsabwicklung in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Aufgaben: • Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, u.a. bei der Erstellung von Versandpapieren, der Anlage und Betreuung von Projekten in SAP • Du betreust eigenverantwortlich Aufgabenstellungen im Rahmen der Auftragsabwicklung mit weltweitem Bezug • Du unterstützt beim Zahlungsmanagement für Leistungen externer Vertriebspartner • Du erstellst Auswertungen mit Hilfe von SAP • Du unterstützt in laufenden internen Projekten (z.B. in Bezug auf Prozessverbesserungen) Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) in einem wirtschaftlichen Studiengang • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit SAP • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise vervollständigt dein Profil Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent customer service and keeping processes running smoothly? As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will be the key link between our customers and internal teams, including Technical Advisors and Product Master Data Specialists.
In this role, you will coordinate all activities related to spare parts quotation and order processes. Your goal will be to provide customers with accurate, high-quality quotations as quickly as possible, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience from request to order. Aufgaben: • Receive and review customer requests: Accept and evaluate customer inquiries for service-related offerings (e.g. spare parts). Ensure requests are complete and determine appropriate next steps. • Initiate and prepare quotations in ERP (e.g., SAP): Create and process quotations for various customer requirements within the relevant system, ensuring accurate entry of all relevant information. • Communicate effectively with customers: Manage communications with customers regarding their requests and quotations, answering questions, clarifying details, and managing expectations throughout the process. • Complete technical and commercial details: gather, verify, and input all necessary technical specifications and commercial terms to ensure comprehensive and precise quotations. • Ensure efficient information flow: Collect and provide all necessary information and supporting documentation to streamline processing by internal specialists and stakeholders. Anforderungen: • Diploma from upper secondary school in an electrical or mechanical field or equivalent education through other educational paths • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems • Highly structured, detail-oriented, and conscientious way of working, ability to use time and resources efficiently • Fluent in the local language and English Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

titleByLocale.it: Direttore of Application Technology - la Casting North America
titleByLocale.en: Director of Application Technology - Die Casting North America
titleByLocale.de: Direktor of Application Technology - Die Casting North America
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur of Application Technology - Die Casting North America

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler technologies touch billions of people every day by enabling safe food and sustainable mobility. One billion people travel in vehicles with parts produced using Buhler equipment. With this global relevance, we transform today's challenges into sustainable, scalable, and profitable solutions.
The Department Manager Application Technology NAM leads the regional Application Technology function for Die Casting in North America, serving as the primary liaison for advanced process support from initial casting concepts through finished products. This role is part of the Global Die Casting Application Technology organization and partners with Sales, Quotation, Engineering, Customer Service, and Global Product Management to deliver best-in-class technical guidance, process optimization, and training that drives customer success and business growth. Aufgaben: • Lead, develop, and mentor the North American Application Technology team; build capabilities, succession plans, and a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement in close collaboration with the Global Application Technology team • Own the regional application strategy and roadmap aligned to global product strategy; translate market and customer insights into actionable requirements for Product Management • Collaborate with customers on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) to optimize casting designs and reduce total cost of ownership • Proactively drive HPDC applications for future automotive platforms by supporting OEMs in early design and development of future body-in-white, powertrain, battery and chassis components • Co-develop with customers their manufacturing quality framework, including quality standards, process control plans, operational standards for die and equipment maintenance, in-process operations, and post-processing • Support strategic key accounts with process optimization plans and productivity improvement programs • Participate in the proposal engineering process for customer opportunities by defining process/part flow, machine & peripheral equipment requirements, & creating customized customer presentations tailored to the opportunity • Drive revenue development across the local team, in addition to involving the global team, by proactively initiating opportunities and responding to customer requests for part development, process support, trials, and training - converting technical engagements into reoccurring turnover opportunities • Keep in contact with leading universities in the field of HPDC in the NAM region • DC technology scouting: Identify emerging technologies that might expand the application of HPDC and/or improve current HPDC production • Represent Bühler at industry events, technical conferences and seminars, as a subject-matter expert. • Works cross-functionally with Sales and Customer Service to lead operational efforts for Bühler Service Agreements and all other support opportunities to build revenue streams • Financial targets: Setting of and achievement of annual budgets including: • NAM applications and training budget (OR, TO and DB1) • NAM cost budget and cost center coverage Anforderungen: Required Skill and Experience: • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other equivalent training or experience • Deep understanding of high-pressure die casting process and machinery, automation, peripherals (spray systems, ladlers, extractors, thermal control, etc) • Proven experience improving casting quality, yield, cycle time, and OEE through process optimization and data-driven problem solving. • Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical teams and cross-functional initiatives. • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) with the ability to influence at all organizational levels and within customer hierarchies. • Strong customer relationship management and consultative skills. • Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft 365 Preferred Skill and Experience • Experience with Bühler die casting solutions or comparable OEM / Tier 1 experience • Knowledge of die design fundamentals, thermal management, lubricants, and alloy behavior (e.g., Al, Mg, Zn). • Experience with simulation, process monitoring, and analytics tools (e.g., Flow3D, Magmasoft,). • Experience in a global matrix organization a plus. • Leadership skills in local and international environments • Ability to work accurately and reliably under pressure • Coaching of employees in professional and personal development • Strong leadership personality and sense for people development • Target and results oriented • Openness, teamwork, flexibility • Above average personal commitment, independence and readiness for action • Multicultural understanding and sensitivity Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler Aufgaben: • Lead, develop, and mentor the North American Application Technology team; build capabilities, succession plans, and a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement in close collaboration with the Global Application Technology team • Own the regional application strategy and roadmap aligned to global product strategy; translate market and customer insights into actionable requirements for Product Management • Collaborate with customers on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) to optimize casting designs and reduce total cost of ownership • Proactively drive HPDC applications for future automotive platforms by supporting OEMs in early design and development of future body-in-white, powertrain, battery and chassis components • Co-develop with customers their manufacturing quality framework, including quality standards, process control plans, operational standards for die and equipment maintenance, in-process operations, and post-processing • Support strategic key accounts with process optimization plans and productivity improvement programs • Participate in the proposal engineering process for customer opportunities by defining process/part flow, machine & peripheral equipment requirements, & creating customized customer presentations tailored to the opportunity • Drive revenue development across the local team, in addition to involving the global team, by proactively initiating opportunities and responding to customer requests for part development, process support, trials, and training - converting technical engagements into reoccurring turnover opportunities • Keep in contact with leading universities in the field of HPDC in the NAM region • DC technology scouting: Identify emerging technologies that might expand the application of HPDC and/or improve current HPDC production • Represent Bühler at industry events, technical conferences and seminars, as a subject-matter expert. • Works cross-functionally with Sales and Customer Service to lead operational efforts for Bühler Service Agreements and all other support opportunities to build revenue streams • Financial targets: Setting of and achievement of annual budgets including: • NAM applications and training budget (OR, TO and DB1) • NAM cost budget and cost center coverage Anforderungen: Required Skill and Experience: • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other equivalent training or experience • Deep understanding of high-pressure die casting process and machinery, automation, peripherals (spray systems, ladlers, extractors, thermal control, etc) • Proven experience improving casting quality, yield, cycle time, and OEE through process optimization and data-driven problem solving. • Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical teams and cross-functional initiatives. • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) with the ability to influence at all organizational levels and within customer hierarchies. • Strong customer relationship management and consultative skills. • Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft 365 Preferred Skill and Experience • Experience with Bühler die casting solutions or comparable OEM / Tier 1 experience • Knowledge of die design fundamentals, thermal management, lubricants, and alloy behavior (e.g., Al, Mg, Zn). • Experience with simulation, process monitoring, and analytics tools (e.g., Flow3D, Magmasoft,). • Experience in a global matrix organization a plus. • Leadership skills in local and international environments • Ability to work accurately and reliably under pressure • Coaching of employees in professional and personal development • Strong leadership personality and sense for people development • Target and results oriented • Openness, teamwork, flexibility • Above average personal commitment, independence and readiness for action • Multicultural understanding and sensitivity Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The Service Agreements Regional Partner is responsible for driving the growth and execution of service agreements across Southeast Asia. This role partners closely with the Sales organization to expand Bühler's service portfolio by identifying opportunities, developing tailored contractual solutions, and securing long-term service agreements. The position plays a critical role in defining commercial structures, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering customer success through strong contractual partnerships. Aufgaben:
• Take full ownership of the assigned portfolio of service agreements (e.g., Remote Services, Inspection, and Maintenance), ensuring delivery excellence and high customer satisfaction.
• Develop and lead a regional support structure, including quotation management, contract delivery, and back-office operations.
• Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual service matters, ensuring timely and effective execution aligned with customer expectations.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts, and Automation teams to deliver integrated service solutions.
• Drive operational excellence and standardization of service agreement management across the SEA region.
• Oversee contract renewal processes, pricing strategies, and cost control measures to maintain profitability.
• Develop and present integrated service proposals that balance customer needs with business objectives.
• Support the identification, development, quotation, and negotiation of complex service agreements.
• Establish and maintain region-specific cost calculation models in alignment with global guidelines.
• Work with technical, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and competitive proposals.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation of quotations, contracts, and handover processes.
• Communicate proactively with stakeholders on proposal status, pricing updates, and contract execution progress.
• Collaborate with global teams to share insights and continuously improve service offerings and customer experience.
• Support the implementation of service frameworks, processes, tools, and best practices within the region Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in value-based selling or front-end commercial roles.
• Strong understanding of maintenance strategies and planning methodologies.
• Solid commercial acumen, including pricing, cost management, and risk assessment.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken).
• Self-motivated with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and results-driven approach.
• Ability to operate effectively within a matrix organization across multiple countries and business units.
• Proven ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. descriptionByLocale.it:
The Quotation Specialist supports Customer Service, Outside Sales, and Bühler Group teams by preparing accurate quotations, processing orders, coordinating internal documentation, and supporting customer growth. This role helps develop existing and new customer opportunities, contributes to monthly sales targets at appropriate gross margins, and ensures timely, professional communication throughout the quotation and order process.
The position serves as an internal coordinator from initial customer request through order receipt and delivery, working closely with customers, vendors, sales, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, finance, accounting, purchasing, and shipping. Aufgaben: • Respond to customer inquiries and direct requests to the appropriate contact when needed. • Understand the customers' needs; able to accurately identify spare parts, calculate pricing, and provide detailed shipping information & documentation. • Prepare cost sheets, quotations, and customer proposals. • Coordinate with vendors, procurement, engineering, and manufacturing to obtain current pricing, lead times, and product information. • Price manufactured items while supporting standard margin objectives. • Work with outside sales engineers to develop complete and accurate proposals. • Follow up with customers on proposal status and provide updates on order status. • Review new projects with engineering as needed. • Review historical documentation and databases to support quotation and order accuracy. • Investigate quality issues & customer complaints; understand the root cause and implement quality gates to prevent recurrence. • Participate in departmental training and continuous improvement efforts • Other tasks as deemed necessary by management. Anforderungen: Job Specifications • Bachelor's degree is a plus but not required. • 1–3 years of inside sales, customer service, or related experience preferred. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite with exceptional verbal, written, and communication skills. • Experience with business systems such as SAP and CRM • Mechanical mindset with aptitude for navigating the Windchill environment to access, interpret, and process engineering drawings, CAD models, and BOMs Knowledge, Skills and Abilities • Strong organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with accuracy and attention to detail. • Professional communication skills, both verbal and written. • Ability to build strong working relationships with customers, vendors, colleagues, and internal departments. • Customer-focused mindset with strong service, quality, value, and reliability orientation. • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while following company guidelines. • Sound judgment, timely decision-making, and willingness to take responsibility. • Ability to identify risks, propose solutions, and support continuous improvement. • Flexibility, adaptability, and openness to change. • Strong teamwork, conflict-resolution, and cross-functional coordination skills. • Professional appearance, self-confidence, persistence, and self-motivation. • Industry awareness, including competitors, market trends, and business opportunities. • Keen investigator and researcher; proficient at finding missing details • Buhler TOP value proponent; contributes to improving the company culture Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Buhler Group a Izmir, Türkiye, sta cercando un professionista qualificato e proattivo per unirsi al nostro Service Operations Team come Lead Project Operations. Il ruolo sarà responsabile di coordinare e monitorare i progetti attivi di assistenza e impianti, assicurando l'allineamento tra ingegneria, clienti, team locali con l'esecuzione delle pietre miliari, risoluzione dei problemi, e le attività di installazione e messa in servizio di successo. Il ruolo richiede un forte impegno per la qualità, la consegna on-time, la soddisfazione del cliente e il rispetto delle direttive Bühler e degli standard Ambiente, Salute e Sicurezza (EHS). Aufgaben:
• Coordinare e monitorare tutti i progetti attivi di servizi e impianti all'interno dell'organizzazione locale.
• Agire come l'interfaccia principale tra i clienti, Service Project Engineers, team locali e organizzazioni di progetto Bühler globali.
• Gli ingegneri e l'allineamento dell'ingegneria di supporto durante la pianificazione e l'esecuzione del progetto.
• Traccia le pietre miliari del progetto, i rischi, le deviazioni e i progressi dell'esecuzione, assicurando l'escalation tempestiva e la risoluzione di problemi critici.
• Supporta i Project Manager globali coordinando le risorse locali, la disponibilità del sito, la comunicazione degli stakeholder, l'installazione e le attività di messa in servizio.
• Facilita la collaborazione tra i siti dei clienti, le funzioni ingegneristiche, i team di assistenza e gli stakeholder globali.
• Assicurare il rispetto delle direttive, dei processi e degli standard EHS di Bühler.
• Mantenere le attività di reportistica, documentazione e miglioramento continuo, comprese le lezioni apprese e la pianificazione delle soluzioni di servizio. Anforderungen:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato.
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nel coordinamento dei progetti, nelle operazioni di servizio o negli ambienti di ingegneria industriale.
• Esperienza leader o coordinamento delle squadre interfunzionali.
• Forte comprensione tecnica attraverso discipline ingegneristiche e di processo, con la capacità di tradurre la complessità in esecuzione efficace e coordinamento.
• Fluente in inglese e turco (scritto e parlato).
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Volontà di viaggiare e lavorare ore flessibili quando necessario.
• Soggiornare nella regione di Izmir o Manisa. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Buhler Group in Izmir, Türkiye, is looking for a skilled and proactive professional to join our Service Operations Team as a Project Operations Lead. The role will be responsible to coordinate and monitor active Service and Plant Projects, ensuring alignment across engineering, customers, local teams along with driving milestone execution, issue resolution, and successful installation and commissioning activities. The role requires a strong commitment to quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and compliance with Bühler directives and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.

Aufgaben:
• Coordinate and monitor all active Service and Plant Projects within the local organization.

• Act as the primary interface between customers, Service Project Engineers, local teams, and global Bühler project organizations.

• Guide Service Project Engineers and support engineering alignment during project planning and execution.

• Track project milestones, risks, deviations, and execution progress, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of critical issues.

• Support global Project Managers by coordinating local resources, site readiness, stakeholder communication, installation, and commissioning activities.

• Facilitate collaboration between customer sites, engineering functions, service teams, and global stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with Bühler directives, processes, and EHS standards.

• Maintain project reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities, including lessons learned and service solution planning.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Minimum 7 years of experience in project coordination, service operations, or industrial engineering environments.

• Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams.

• Strong technical understanding across engineering and process disciplines, with the ability to translate complexity into effective execution and coordination.

• Fluent in English and Turkish (written and spoken).

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work flexible hours when required.

• Residing in the Izmir or Manisa region.

• Conoscenza solida degli schemi elettrici e dei quadri di controllo/alimentazione

• Motivazione per imparare e lavorare con COMOS

• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica (o un campo simile è un vantaggio)

• Inglese a livello comunicativo (Czech è un plus)

• Analysis of the inactive/lost customers for CS products and define proper action plan to gain back the business

• Analysis of the demand for CS products – understand customer pain points and build spare part package according to their needs

• Develop the activity of Customer Service in coordination with Area Sales Managers, Area Service Managers, Head of Sales and the SAS Manager

• Build an action plan to increase the users for myBuhler and encourage customers to transact via myBuhler

• Develop new business, collect and evaluate about competitors, customer and market trend

• Review operational records and reports to Head of Sales & SAS manager

• Attend trade shows or seminars to promote products

Service Agreement
• Listen and proactively re-solve customer complaints regarding spare parts and services

• Obtain and check all relevant information of complaints and to determine possible problem causes

• Understand customers' complaints, root cause of the problems and paint points from the customers and tailor Service Agreement to their needs

• Actively coordinate with CSOP Managers for the dispatch of FSE to perform problem solving or service sales

Channel Management
• Build – up, develop and manage parts channels for business

• Follow to execute the process of parts channel management with regional team

CS Team Leading
• Build the budget and goals for team and individual people

• Plan and prepare work schedules, and assign employees to specific duties

• Responsible for the budget of sales and keep costs of the CS department within benchmarks.

• Monitor and assess employees performance

• Join the recruitment process, follow any promotions and prepare training plan for the development of the people

• Ensure security and optimal working conditions for the employees.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's Degree in engineering / businees or equivalent

• 5 years experience in Technical Sales and in Customer Service

• 3 years experience in Management

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und Wachstum. Als Teil der globalen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden sind wir führender Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen für Architekturglas, Brillengläser sowie optische Komponenten in Smartphones, Fahrzeugen und der Medizintechnik.

Für unseren Standort Leipzig suchen wir einen motivierten Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain. Sie planen und steuern unsere Supply Chain und tragen so zu einem reibungslosen Projektablauf bei. Wenn Sie Einsatzbereitschaft, Freundlichkeit und Freude an neuen Herausforderungen mitbringen, freuen wir uns auf Sie.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Als Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Leipziger Team und gestalten aktiv die Effizienz unserer Supply Chain mit: • Verantwortung für die Produktionsplanung und -steuerung inklusive aller Supply-Chain-Aktivitäten am Standort • Planung und Steuerung von Montage- und Fertigungsaufträgen • Pflege und Optimierung von Arbeitsplänen, Forecasts, Lageraufträgen und Mindestbeständen • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Einkauf, Produktion und Logistik • Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Schnittstellen in der gesamten Supply Chain • Perspektivisch Übernahme weiterer Verantwortung bis hin zur Teamleitung Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung oder Studium (idealerweise Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) • Fundierte Berufserfahrung in Supply Chain, Produktionsplanung, -steuerung oder Disposition • Idealerweise Branchenerfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau sowie Kenntnisse im Supply Chain Management • Gute ERP-Kenntnisse (vorzugsweise SAP) und sehr sichere MS-Office-Kenntnisse (insbesondere Excel und Power BI von Vorteil) • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Strukturierte, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Einsatzbereitschaft Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Vielfältiger und integrativer Arbeitsplatz Wir fördern eine inklusive Kultur, die unsere globale Vielfalt wertschätzt. Respekt und Empathie sorgen dafür, dass sich alle sicher fühlen und ihr Bestes geben können. Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
As a temporary maternity leave/Shipping Coordinator, you will become part of our team in Skovlunde, which currently consists of 3 employees. You will be responsible for coordinating all types of transport.
This position is a full-time role from November 1, 2026, until February 28, 2027. Aufgaben: • Booking and coordination of national and international courier, air, sea, and road transport • Daily contact with freight forwarders and colleagues at Bühler • Handling of spare parts orders • Preparation and checking of export documents, invoicing, and freight rates • Daily updating and maintenance of data in SAP (knowledge of SAP is not required) • Training in our procedures and work processes Anforderungen: You are a newly qualified Shipping Coordinator/Freight Forwarder or have experience from a similar position. descriptionByLocale.it:
Per il nostro laboratorio analitico stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata e curiosa per uno stage nel campo dell'analisi fisica. In questo ruolo versatile, ci supporterete nella caratterizzazione dei prodotti alimentari e dei materiali tecnici e otterrete interessanti approfondimenti sui metodi di analisi moderni come le dimensioni delle particelle, la viscosità, il colore, la texture e le analisi termiche. Essi lavorano precisamente sulla preparazione del campione, la valutazione e l'interpretazione dei risultati di misura e contribuiscono a rispondere alle domande tecnologiche. Sarete in scambio con il nostro team di laboratorio, partner interni e clienti e può contribuire le vostre abilità analitiche per progetti di sviluppo e svilupparli ulteriormente. Compiti:
• Essi forniscono servizi analitici per la caratterizzazione dei materiali alimentari e tecnici
• Parlano di domande e analisi con clienti, clienti e partner commerciali
• Eseguono analisi di routine come dimensioni delle particelle, viscosità, colore, texture e analisi termiche
• Preparano campioni, valutano i risultati, interpretano i risultati e producono report scritti
• Essi sviluppano inoltre metodi fisici e supportano in modo indipendente le sottozone nei progetti di sviluppo Requisiti
• Laurea in ingegneria o scienze naturali, idealmente in ingegneria meccanica di processo, scienze alimentari o chimica fisica
• Metodo di analisi preciso e persistente
• Divertimento di lavorare insieme in una squadra
• Il pensiero analitico e l'interesse per le questioni tecniche e scientifiche
• Buone capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese, sia orale che scritta Offriamo: Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
For our analytical laboratory we are looking for a committed and curious personality for an internship in the field of physical analytics. In this versatile role, you will support us in the characterization of foodstuffs and technical materials and gain exciting insights into modern analysis methods such as particle size, viscosity, color, texture and thermal analyses. They work precisely on sample preparation, evaluation and interpretation of measurement results and contribute to answering technological questions. You will be in exchange with our laboratory team, internal partners and customers and can contribute your analytical skills to development projects and further develop them. Tasks:
• They provide analytical services for the characterization of food and technical materials
• They discuss questions and analyses with clients, customers and business partners
• They perform routine analyses such as particle size, viscosity, colour, texture and thermal analyses
• They prepare samples, evaluate results, interpret results and produce written reports
• They further develop physical methods and independently support sub-areas in development projects Requirements
• Graduate degree in engineering or natural sciences, ideally in mechanical process engineering, food sciences or physical chemistry
• Precise and persistent method of analysis
• Enjoyment of working together in a team
• Analytical thinking and interest in technical and scientific questions
• Good communication skills in German and English, both oral and written We offer: Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• Sie besprechen Fragestellungen und Analysen mit Auftraggebenden, Kundschaft und Geschäftspartnern
• Sie führen Routineanalysen wie Partikelgrössen-, Viskositäts-, Farb-, Textur- und Thermoanalysen durch
• Sie bereiten Proben vor, werten Ergebnisse aus, interpretieren Resultate und erstellen schriftliche Berichte
• Sie entwickeln physikalische Methoden weiter und unterstützen selbständig Teilbereiche in Entwicklungsprojekten Anforderungen:
• Studienabschluss im Bereich Technik oder Naturwissenschaften, idealerweise in mechanischer Verfahrenstechnik, Lebensmittelwissenschaften oder physikalischer Chemie
