Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join our dynamic team as a Sales Account Manager and become a key player in shaping the future of the grain industry! In this role, you'll be driving the promotion and sales of Bühler's innovative Wheat and Rye equipment across the US territory. Your mission will be to craft and execute sales strategies, engage with both existing and potential clients, and uncover their unique needs to deliver tailored solutions. You'll spearhead the development of both existing and new business opportunities while gathering invaluable market insights. If you're passionate about sales and ready to take on exciting challenges, we want you to be part of our journey towards transforming the industry! Aufgaben:
• Direct sales, promoting and selling the Buhler equipment and related equipment in a defined geography
• Develop and implement a sales plan for market and account coverage
• Prospecting, identifying new customers and working with existing owners to ensure that Buhler machinery is top of mind for all new projects
• Manages and maintains assigned accounts and key accounts
• Fosters customer relationships
• Develops and establishes new accounts
• Customer contact, collecting information, negotiating contracts
• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to customer orders or concerns
• Collects market data (customer and competition) that show the need of the businesses and industries within the territory
• Generating enquiries, filling out internal RFQ's and presenting quotes and proposals to the customer
• Close sales to meet or exceed a sales quota
• Attend trade shows as required, attend customer FATs, and travel to Europe as required
• Attend trainings in Europe as needed
• File customer contact reports, call reports and other pertinent information in a CRM
• Other duties as assigned Anforderungen:
• Bachelors Degree in Business, Engineering or equivalent
• Background in Food/Agriculture industry strongly preferred
• Strong mechanical/technical acumen desired
• 5+ years selling capital goods to the food industry
• Attention to detail
• Excellent organization, interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing internally and externally
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
• Strong market and commercial awareness
• Ability to build relationships internally and externally while working across time zones and cultures
• A sales leader who can inspire others
• Experience in key account management and directing key account sales teams
• Interpersonal - considers the needs and feelings of others and appropriately responds to different situations
• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures
• Advanced MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
• Oral and Written Communication - presents information, analysis, and ideas in writing in a clear and concise manner; speaks clearly so that others can hear and understand what is being said
• Speaks and understands English, German and/or Spanish a plus
• Domestic and international travel 65% of time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti al nostro team globale di Servizi Finanziari e Affari Commerciali e aiuta a modellare i processi doganali e commerciali in un'organizzazione internazionale a matrice. Come Global Customs Advisor presso la nostra sede a Uzwil, sosterrai sia le nostre business unit locali che le nostre filiali globali come partner chiave per lo sdoganamento, la conformità e l'ottimizzazione dei processi. Con la tua esperienza, guiderai la progettazione dei processi di importazione ed esportazione, sosterrà la determinazione dell'origine delle merci e consiglierà su un'ampia gamma di questioni commerciali estere. Questa è un'occasione emozionante per assumere un ruolo con portata internazionale e impatto reale sulle imprese. Aufgaben:
• Lei è il consulente doganale globale e fornisce una guida specializzata sui processi di importazione/esportazione, sull'origine delle merci e su altre questioni relative al commercio estero
• Lei consiglia e sostiene attivamente le nostre unità commerciali in Uzwil e filiali globali sullo sdoganamento, l'ottimizzazione e le domande relative all'origine
• Lei rappresenta argomenti commerciali esteri in progetti interni del Gruppo, processo di guida, dati e miglioramenti IT e sostiene SAP GTS rollouts attraverso sedi del Gruppo
• Lei monitora gli sviluppi del commercio estero regionale e globale, valuta il loro impatto sulle catene di approvvigionamento e sulla competitività, e Trasferire le competenze in materia di controllo doganale e di origine, svolgere sessioni di formazione e fungere da punto di contatto centrale per autorità e associazioni Anforderungen:
• Laurea in amministrazione aziendale o qualifica analoga, idealmente con una specializzazione nel commercio estero
• Esperti esperti in diritto doganale svizzero ed europeo, combinati con una solida esperienza pratica nel settore doganale e del commercio estero, preferibilmente all'interno di un ambiente industriale internazionale
• Servizio orientato, resiliente e personalità impegnata con forti capacità comunicative e capacità di comunicazione Interagire con fiducia con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni in un ambiente globale
• Buona conoscenza di lavoro delle applicazioni SAP R/3, SAP GTS e MS Office
• Ottimo comando dell'inglese e del tedesco, sia scritto che parlato Wirbieten: Attraente diritto alla vacation Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacation all'anno a seconda dell'età. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo una OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + travelcard a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una carta di viaggio di prima classe attraente o parcheggio gratuito. Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso l'addestramento auto-organizzato del circuito e gruppi di corsa, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e la fitness Activ. VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF. Piani pensionistici finanziati dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensione Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port Ci impegniamo a prevenire l'assistenza sanitaria attraverso analisi di laboratorio, trucchi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler punta a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sblocchino opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join our global Financial Services and Trade Affairs team and help shape customs and foreign trade processes in an international matrix organization. As a Global Customs Advisor at our headquarters in Uzwil, you will support both our local business units and our global subsidiaries as a key partner in customs clearance, compliance, and process optimization. With your expertise, you will drive the design of import and export processes, support the determination of origin of goods, and advise on a wide range of foreign trade matters. This is an exciting opportunity to take on a role with international reach and real business impact. Aufgaben:
• You serve as the Global Customs Advisor and provide expert guidance on import/export processes, origin of goods, and other foreign trade-related matters
• You advise and actively support our business units in Uzwil and global subsidiaries on customs clearance, optimization, and origin-related questions
• You represent foreign trade topics in internal Group projects, drive process, data, and IT improvements, and support SAP GTS rollouts across Group locations
• You monitor regional and global foreign trade developments, assess their impact on supply chains and competitiveness, and derive relevant actions
• You independently manage customs and origin checks, deliver training sessions, and act as the central point of contact for authorities and associations Anforderungen:
• Degree in business administration or a comparable qualification, ideally with a specialization in foreign trade
• Extensive expertise in Swiss and EU customs law, combined with solid hands-on experience in customs and foreign trade, preferably within an international industrial environment
• Service-oriented, resilient, and committed personality with strong communication skills and the ability to interact confidently with internal and external stakeholders in a global environment
• Good working knowledge of SAP R/3, SAP GTS, and MS Office applications
• Very good command of English and German, both written and spoken Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Health-Port We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Begleiten Sie unser globales Financial Services and Trade Affairs Team und helfen Sie bei der Gestaltung von Zoll- und Außenhandelsprozessen in einer internationalen Matrixorganisation. Als Global Customs Advisor an unserem Hauptsitz in Uzwil unterstützen Sie sowohl unsere lokalen Geschäftseinheiten als auch unsere globalen Tochtergesellschaften als Schlüsselpartner bei der Zollabwicklung, Compliance und Prozessoptimierung. Mit Ihrer Expertise treiben Sie die Gestaltung von Import- und Exportprozessen, unterstützen die Bestimmung der Herkunft von Waren und beraten Sie in einem breiten Spektrum von Außenhandelsangelegenheiten. Dies ist eine spannende Gelegenheit, eine Rolle mit internationaler Reichweite und echten Geschäftseffekten zu übernehmen.
• Sie beraten und unterstützen aktiv unsere Geschäftseinheiten in Uzwil und globalen Tochtergesellschaften bei Zollabfertigungs-, Optimierungs- und Herkunftsfragen
• Sie vertreten Außenhandelsthemen in internen Konzernprojekten, Antriebsprozessen, Daten und IT-Verbesserungen und unterstützen SAP GTS Rollouts konzernübergreifend
• Sie überwachen regionale und globale Außenhandelsentwicklungen, bewerten deren Auswirkungen auf Lieferketten und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und

Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Engagement und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Volete contribuire ai processi produttivi di domani con la vostra esperienza di processo. dai materiali delle batterie agli ioni di litio agli inchiostri da stampa analogici e digitali agli inchiostri agrochimici? Nella nostra area di business, Grinding & Dispersing, troverete un ambiente innovativo e dinamico dove condurrete test nel laboratorio applicativo, fornirete consulenza tecnica e accompagnerete progetti di sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei processi entusiasmanti. Entrate a far parte del nostro team in Uzwil e contribuire attivamente al vostro know-how come tecnologo di processo. Attività:
• Siete responsabili dell'esecuzione dei test di base e di sviluppo del cliente nel laboratorio applicativo, nonché della presentazione e comunicazione degli esperimenti nel team di produzione, nei nostri uffici, agenti e clienti
• Si consiglia clienti interni ed esterni su questioni di ingegneria di processo e sviluppare continuamente servizi di consulenza clienti e l'esperienza del cliente nel laboratorio applicativo
• Si lavora con progetti di sviluppo e ottimizzazione dei processi e agire come persona di contatto tecnico di processo
• Si supporta il Team di vendita e ingegneria per nuovi processi e progetti di impianti, comprese visite congiunte ai clienti
• Sopravviverete la formazione di ingegneria di processo di dipendenti interni e clienti Requisiti:
• Studi di ingegneria completati (Uni/FH) nel campo dell'ingegneria di processo, ingegneria meccanica, sviluppo di materiali, chimica o area tematica analoga
• Esperienza nella tecnica di miscelazione, dispersione e rettifica a umido, in particolare con miscelatori, mulini a sfere agitatori e mulini a tre rulli, nonché nella gestione dei metodi di analisi standard dell'industria verniciante e verniciante
• Ottima Conoscenza dell'ufficio MS e ottime competenze in tedesco e inglese
• Personalità innovativa, comunicativa e flessibile con metodi di lavoro indipendenti, aperti e mirati
• Fino al 30% di disponibilità ai viaggi Offriamo: Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menù di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9 00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + mezza tassa per 365 CHF + 400CHF di credito di Piani pensionistici finanziati dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensione Bühler offre ai propri dipendenti un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce un affidabile isolamento finanziario di pensionamento: www.pk-buhler.ch Richiesta vacanze attraente Tempo adeguato per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di ferie all'anno a seconda dell'età dell'anno. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili via Mobilezone a Sunrise e S.O.O.O. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto sulle piante Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte da Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler mira a allineare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nelle industrie globali dell'alimentazione, dei mangimi e della mobilità. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Per questo motivo lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Would you like to contribute to the production processes of tomorrow with your process expertise – from lithium-ion battery materials to analog and digital printing inks to agrochemicals? In our business area, Grinding & Dispersing, you will find an innovative and dynamic environment where you will conduct tests in the application laboratory, provide technical advice and accompany exciting development and process optimization projects. Become part of our team in Uzwil and actively contribute your know-how as a process technologist – we look forward to seeing you! Tasks:
• You are responsible for carrying out customer, basic and development tests in the application laboratory as well as for the presentation and communication of the experiments in the production team, our offices, agents and customers
• You advise internal and external customers on process engineering issues and continuously develop customer consulting services and the customer experience in the application laboratory
• You work with development and process optimization projects and act as a process technical contact person
• You support the Sales and engineering team for new processes and plant projects, including joint customer visits
• You take over the process engineering training of internal employees and customers Requirements:
• Completed engineering studies (Uni/FH) in the field of process engineering, mechanical engineering, material development, chemistry or similar subject area
• Experience in mixing, dispersion and wet grinding technology, in particular with mixers, agitator ball mills and three-roll mills, as well as in the handling of standard analysis methods of the paint and varnish industry
• Very good MS Office knowledge and very good German and English skills
• Innovative, communicative and flexible personality with independent, open and targeted working methods
• Up to 30% willingness to travel We offer: Personalrestaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu starting from 9 00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF ÖV credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking.Health-Port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutrition advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers its employees an independent pension fund that ensures a reliable retirement financial isolation: www.pk-buhler.ch Attractive holiday claim Adequate time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the age of the year. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and S.O.O.O.. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler. With every decision, Bühler aims to bring the needs of the economy, people and nature into line. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Milling Solutions è il leader nella produzione di farine e semola di alta qualità, prodotti di grano, duro, segale e mais. Per rafforzare il nostro team all'Accademia di Milling, siamo alla ricerca di una personalità impegnata e intraprendente come Instructor Process Technology. Aufgaben:
• Formate il personale del cliente e i dipendenti interni nella tecnologia di fresatura, sia presso l'Accademia di Milling che in loco attraverso la formazione pratica
• create, aggiornate e mantenete materiali di formazione e documentazione del corso, familiarizzando continuamente con nuove tecnologie e attrezzature
• definite e sviluppate ulteriormente i contenuti del corso insieme al team per garantire programmi di formazione di alta qualità e aggiornati
• Supportate i clienti e i partecipanti del corso fornendo assistenza professionale, organizzando visite e rappresentazioni e assicurando un contenuto positivo complessivo
• L'esperienza di formazione
• L'assistenza tecnica e amministrativa viene fornita ai servizi di assistenza e tecnologia, comprese le attività di supporto alle vendite, quali ispezioni dei mulini e assistenza tecnica nelle discussioni Anforderungen:
• Formazione professionale completata come miller o qualifica equivalente, idealmente combinata con una formazione tecnica avanzata nella fresatura (ad es. Scuola Svizzera di fresatura, DMSB, o simili), oltre a diversi anni di esperienza pratica nel settore della macinazione
• Profonda esperienza tecnica in grano, duro, avena e mais, compresa una conoscenza dettagliata di macchinari, aspirazione e pneumatica, completata da una conoscenza di base della tecnologia elettrica e dell'automazione
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale per ispezioni di mulino, formazione dei clienti e supporto in loco, combinata con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in diverse culture e ambienti
• Indipendente, responsabile e motivante personalità con forte forza abilità di lavoro di gruppo, la capacità di rimanere calmi sotto pressione, e una presenza sicura e professionale quando rappresenta l'azienda esternamente
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in arabo, francese e inglese, sia scritto e parlato; lingue aggiuntive come il tedesco o lo spagnolo sono un vantaggio Wirbiet: Attraente diritto di vacanza Abbastanza tempo per rilassarsi e interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + travelcard a metà prezzo per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente biglietto da viaggio di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito.VIVA Restaurant Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero a partire da 9, 00 CHF.Piano pensionistico finanziato dai datori di lavoro Il Fondo Pensioni Bühler offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensionistico indipendente che garantisce sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch Abbonamenti per cellulari Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti per cellulari via Mobilezone con Sunrise e Swisscom. Attività sportive Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione auto-organizzata del circuito e gruppi di corsa così come i buoni per l'aggiornamento e la Fitness Activ. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Milling Solutions is the leading specialist in state-of-the-art process technologies for producing high-quality flour and semolina products from wheat, durum, rye, and corn. To strengthen our team in the Milling Academy, we are looking for a committed, entrepreneurial-minded personality as Instructor Process Technology. Aufgaben:
• You train customer personnel and internal employees in milling technology, both at the Milling Academy and on-site through hands-on training
• You create, update, and maintain training materials and course documentation, while continuously familiarizing yourself with new technologies and equipment
• You define and further develop course content together with the team to ensure high-quality and up-to-date training programs
• You support customers and course participants by providing professional guidance, organizing visits and representations, and ensuring a positive overall training experience
• You provide technological and administrative support to the Customer Service and Technology departments, including sales-supporting activities such as mill inspections and technical assistance in discussions Anforderungen:
• Completed vocational training as a miller or an equivalent qualification, ideally combined with advanced technical education in milling (e.g. Swiss School of Milling, DMSB, or similar), as well as several years of practical experience in the milling industry
• Profound technical expertise in wheat, durum, oat, and corn milling, including detailed knowledge of machinery, aspiration, and pneumatics, complemented by a basic understanding of electrical and automation technology
• Willingness to travel internationally for mill inspections, customer training, and on-site support, combined with the ability to work effectively across different cultures and environments
• Independent, responsible, and motivating personality with strong teamwork skills, the ability to stay calm under pressure, and a confident and professional presence when representing the company externally
• Strong communication skills in Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken; additional languages such as German or Spanish are an advantage Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. VIVA Restaurant We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. Employer-funded pension plan The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch Mobile phone subscriptions We offer special conditions for cell phone subscriptions via Mobilezone with Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bühler Milling Solutions ist der führende Spezialist für modernste Prozesstechnologien zur Herstellung hochwertiger Mehl- und Semolina-Produkte aus Weizen, Durum, Roggen und Mais. Um unser Team in der Milling Academy zu stärken, suchen wir eine engagierte, unternehmerische Persönlichkeit als Instructor Process Technology.
• Sie bilden Kundenpersonal und interne Mitarbeiter in der Frästechnik aus, sowohl an der Fräsakademie als auch vor Ort durch praktisches Training
• Sie erstellen, aktualisieren und pflegen Trainingsmaterialien und Kursdokumentationen, während Sie sich kontinuierlich mit neuen Technologien und Geräten vertraut machen
• Sie definieren und entwickeln gemeinsam mit dem Team Kursinhalte, um hochwertige und aktuelle Trainingsprogramme zu gewährleisten
• Sie unterstützen Kunden und Kursteilnehmer durch professionelle Beratung, Organisation von Besuchen und Vertretungen und gewährleisten ein insgesamt positives Gesamtergebnis Ausbildung
• Sie unterstützen die Abteilungen Kundenservice und Technologie technisch und administrativ, einschließlich der vertriebsunterstützenden Tätigkeiten wie Mühleninspektionen und technische Hilfe in Diskussionen.
• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Müller oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation, idealerweise kombiniert mit fortgeschrittener technischer Ausbildung im Fräsen (z.B. Swiss School of Milling, DMSB, oder ähnliches), sowie mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Fräsindustrie
• Gefundene technische Expertise in Weizen-, Hartweizen-, Hafer- und Maisfräsen, einschließlich detaillierter Kenntnisse der Maschinen, Aspiration und Pneumatik, ergänzt durch ein grundlegendes Verständnis der Elektro- und Automatisierungstechnik
• Bereitschaft, international für Mühleninspektionen, Kundenschulungen und Vor-Ort-Support zu reisen, kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in verschiedenen Kulturen und Umgebungen zu arbeiten
• Unabhängig, verantwortlich und motivieren Persönlichkeit mit starken Teamfähigkeit, die Fähigkeit, unter Druck ruhig zu bleiben, und eine selbstbewusste und professionelle Präsenz bei der Vertretung des Unternehmens extern
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Arabisch, Französisch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen; zusätzliche Sprachen wie Deutsch oder Spanisch sind ein Vorteil Wir Sieg: Attraktiver Urlaubsrecht Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten je nach Alter von 25 bis 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr an. Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept Wir bieten eine OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtarifreisekarte für CHF 365 + CHF 400 öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie eine attraktive First-Class-Reisekarte oder kostenlose Parkplätze.VIVA Restaurant Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9, 00 CHF.Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Pensionskasse Der Bühler Pensionskasse bietet Bühler Mitarbeitern einen unabhängigen Pensionsfonds, der im Ruhestand eine zuverlässige finanzielle Absicherung gewährleistet: www.pk-buhler.ch Handyabos Wir bieten spezielle Konditionen für Handyabos über die Mobilezone mit Sunrise und Swisscom. Sportaktivitäten Wir fördern körperliche Aktivität durch selbstorganisierte Schaltungstrainings- und Laufgruppen sowie Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft in jeder Entscheidung zu balancieren, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir streben Innovationen für eine bessere Welt an, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und Hochschulen zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.

Pour renforcer notre équipe dans l'Académie de fraisage, nous recherchons une personnalité engagée et entrepreneuriale comme la technologie de processus d'instructeur. Aufgaben:
• Vous formez le personnel client et les employés internes à la technologie de fraisage, tant à l'Académie de fraisage que sur place par la formation pratique
• Vous créez, mettez à jour et maintenez du matériel de formation et de la documentation de cours, tout en vous familiarisant continuellement avec les nouvelles technologies et équipements
• Vous définissez et développez davantage le contenu des cours avec l'équipe afin d'assurer des programmes de formation de haute qualité et à jour
• Vous aidez les clients et les participants en leur fournissant des conseils professionnels, en organisant des visites et des représentations et en assurant une formation positive dans l'ensemble
• Vous fournissez un soutien technologique et administratif aux services de la clientèle et de la technologie, y compris des activités de soutien à la vente telles que des inspections des usines et une assistance technique dans les discussions. L'école suisse de meunier, DMSB ou similaire) ainsi que plusieurs années d'expérience pratique dans l'industrie de la meunier
• Une expertise technique approfondie dans le secteur du blé, du blé dur, de l'avoine et du maïs, y compris une connaissance détaillée des machines, des aspirations et des pneumatiques, complétée par une compréhension de base de la technologie électrique et d'automatisation
• La volonté de voyager à l'international pour des inspections des usines, la formation des clients et le soutien sur place, combinée à la capacité de travailler efficacement dans différentes cultures et environnements
• Une personnalité indépendante, responsable et motivante avec une forte compétences en travail d'équipe, la capacité de rester calme sous la pression, et une présence confiante et professionnelle lors de la représentation externe de l'entreprise
• Fortes compétences en communication en arabe, français et anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée; des langues supplémentaires comme l'allemand ou l'espagnol sont un avantage Wir bieten: Attractive vacances qualifiante Assez de temps pour la détente et les intérêts personnels - nous offrons de 25 à 30 jours de vacances par an selon l'âge. Concept de mobilité attractive Nous offrons une carte de voyage ZVV / Z-Pass + demi-tarif pour CHF 365 + CHF 400 crédit de transport en commun ainsi qu'une carte de voyage de première classe attrayante ou un parking gratuit. VIVA Restaurant Nous offrons à nos employés un menu de fitness quotidien à partir de 9,00 CHF. Régime de retraite financé par l'employeur La Caisse de retraite Bühler offre aux salariés de Bühler une caisse de retraite indépendante qui assure une sécurité financière fiable en retraite : www.pk-buhler.ch Abonnements mobiles Nous offrons des conditions spéciales pour les abonnements de téléphones cellulaires via Mobilezone avec Sunrise et Swisscom. Activités sportives Nous encourageons l'activité physique par l'entraînement auto-organisé de circuits et de groupes de course ainsi que des bons de mise à jour et de fitness Activ. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui permettent de libérer des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Nous faisons donc équipe avec nos clients, nos start-ups, nos multinationales et nos universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten.

Um die Verfügbarkeit unserer Anlagen sicher zu stellen, brauchen unsere Kunden regelmäßig Verschleiß- und Ersatzteile. In der Funktion als Technischer Kundenberater (m/w/d) sind Sie für den technisch korrekten Inhalt unserer Angebote verantwortlich.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Annahme globaler Supportanfragen (intern und extern) bezüglich Ersatzteile • Analyse der Anfragen und Bestimmung weiterer Maßnahmen • Erarbeitung von komplexen Offerten inklusive Identifikation der benötigten Ersatzteile mittels technischer Dokumente (Ersatzteilkataloge, technische Zeichnungen, Stücklisten etc.) • Ausarbeitung empfohlener Ersatzteillisten • Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen und Koordination zwischen Vertrieb und Entwicklung • Überwachung und Pflege relevanter Customer Service Daten in technischen Dokumentationen Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Konstruktions-, Feinwerkmechanik, Metallbau o.ä.) vorzugsweise gepaart mit kaufmännischer Erfahrung bzw. Weiterbildung oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Erfahrung im technischen Umfeld in vergleichbarer Funktion • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten • Versiert im Umgang mit dem MS-Office-Paket und SAP • Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Bereitschaft komplexe, globale Prozesse und Systeme zu verstehen • Engagierte, belastbare und flexible Persönlichkeit Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksame Leistungen Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksamen Leistungen – für eine sichere Zukunft! Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Mobiles Arbeiten Wenn es Ihre Tätigkeit zulässt, ist mobiles Arbeiten in Absprache mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich (bis zu 40%). So können Sie Ihr Berufs- und Privatleben in Einklang bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Group in Lagos, Nigeria is looking for a skilled professional to join our team as Sales Channel Manager. This role will focus on driving sustainable business growth across Ghana, Liberia, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, and The Gambia by developing and managing Bühler's channel partner and reseller network. This position will also be responsible for increasing market share, while ensuring strong alignment with Bühler's regional and global strategies. Aufgaben:
• Drive market share growth and profitable business expansion in alignment with Bühler's group and regional strategic plans.
• Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities, including emerging markets, customer segments, and distribution channels.
• Strengthen Bühler's market presence in Nigeria by expanding and optimizing partner, reseller, and distribution networks.
• Develop, manage, and grow channel partner relationships, ensuring partners are effectively onboarded, enabled, and aligned with Bühler's standards and business objectives.
• Monitor partner performance and act as the key interface between external partners and internal stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and business delivery.
• Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and opportunity development to proposal submission, negotiation, and order intake.
• Maintain a transparent and accurate sales pipeline, including CRM updates, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and timely follow-up on leads.
• Drive project and plant sales initiatives in collaboration with internal teams such as Sales Support, Technology, and Service to ensure successful project execution.
• Execute business strategies within the assigned territory, collaborating with regional and global teams to achieve defined sales and growth targets. Anforderungen:
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project sales and/or machine sales
• Experience working in a global or matrix organization
• Proven track record in channel partner or reseller management
• Strong market knowledge of Nigeria and/or Africa Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
